Sentence (English): I'm not paying for a technician visit or buying Samsung again.
Comments (English): [ Really bad dishwasher/ customer service ] || ---------------- || Bad thing I cant give it a 0 star. Be aware, don't buy it. Mine worked for about 3 months before starting giving up. I called Samsung, they sent a technician that fixed the noise issue ( happens when there's water being collect ). Well, we thought it was fixed and it continued leaking little by little, when we notice the bottom of the cabinets were damaged ( it's in a rental unit ). After lots of talk with Samsung they agree to open an exception ( it was just over one year old by then ) and send a technician ( for my bad luck the same one ), the guy moved it out, stayed on the phone with some other technician for about 30 min and put it back ( completely un-leveled, over two pieces of tile - cause he broke the foot base when he removed it ) and said there's no issue. I called Samsung and they said as the technician found no issue with the dishwasher they can't do anything, if I still want to proceed then i should pay for the technician visit myself . After a few days I sent them a new video showing the same issue and the answer is the same: it's out of warranty. I'm not paying for a technician visit or buying Samsung again.

Comments (English): [ Don't Purchase ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher is as basic as they come. I will start with the positive comments. The dishwasher is attractive in appearance and washes dishes. The installers were polite and professional. There you go, all of the good. Now, the rest of the story. It is very cheaply made, the top rack is not conveniently spaced for different sized dishes and cups and tops, it has an unpleasant odor which I thought was a food issue however it is not, the "drying" options do NOT dry well and the dishwasher is loud. We purchased this without looking at it because our current appliances are GE and we love them so why not just replace them with GE appliances, right? We chose a simple basic model because we never really used the extra features on the previous dishwasher. I would not purchase this model for all of the reasons I listed. Spend the extra money and get something of better quality. This was an unfortunate mistake.

Sentence (English): Dishwashers are now a must-have home appliance!
Comments (English): [ I can't live without a dishwasher anymore~ ] || ---------------- || Dishwashers are now a must-have home appliance! A few years ago, my friends raved about it so much that I bought one as a wedding gift. When I first used it, I thought, 'It takes too much time, I have to wash it, and it's a hassle to organize it like Tetris. I don't think I really need one. ' But after living in a place without one for about two years, I really felt the need for one! I hate endless dishwashing. When I moved in September, I reordered the same product I had bought as a wedding gift before the LG dishwasher, but the design from the outside is almost the same, but the tablet detergent compartment and the spoon compartment have also changed. Actually, I think the product I used before was more convenient, so that part is a little disappointing, but it is much more convenient and better than not having it. The design is clean and the color is soft beige, so it is luxurious and pretty. Due to the structure of our kitchen, it had to be installed under the induction, so it cost an extra 100,000 won to raise the induction. And instead of right next to the sink, it had to be installed at a corner where the pipes are exposed. It doesn't look good to have the pipes exposed, but I was worried that it might not be installed, so I am grateful that it worked. The dishwasher says it takes about 2 and a half hours to run once, but after about 2 hours, the door opens automatically and it seems to dry more while hot steam comes out. It is convenient and good that the door opens automatically without having to wait for the end time. I think it is a must-have for homes that cook often or have many family members. The dishes pile up and pile up again, which is stressful, but this product helps reduce that stress a little. It has two compartments, upper and lower. I put heavier and larger dishes, pots, and frying pans in the lower compartment and cups and lighter and smaller dishes in the upper compartment. When I run the dishwasher, I have to pre-wash it first and put it in. There are also a lot of glass and dishes that are not dishwasher-safe, so I can't completely get away from hand washing, but I am satisfied that it is a little helpful. When there is not enough space on the dish drying rack and there are not many dishes to wash, I open it halfway and just use it as a drying rack when I don't run the dishwasher. When I don't want to bother putting all the dried dishes back in their place, I use it as a storage shelf for a while. In fact, since I pre-wash it and put it in, it is cleaned very well, so the difference before and after is not obvious, but sometimes it is not cleaned well. Sentence (English): This is a review I wrote after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Team event.
Comments (English): This is a review I wrote after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Team event. I'm a stay-at-home mom for 10 years. I clean every day, but I've been really hating doing the dishes lately. People around me who use dishwashers highly recommend it, but I've been holding out, saying I'll just do the dishes myself, even if it's a little more difficult. Finally, I received a dishwasher as a gift. ^^ I waited half-heartedly after ordering, but the technician called me quickly and came the next day to install it. The dishwasher was set up in no time. ^^ The technician took out the oven cabinet, removed the dishwasher lid, and installed it perfectly. He even aligned the mop holder perfectly, so I was so grateful. The technician even kindly explained the benefits and how to use the dishwasher beforehand, which made me even more satisfied. ^^ My kitchen is on the small side, but now that the dishwasher fits perfectly, it looks so clean and pretty. ^^ I immediately ordered dishwasher detergent and finally used it for the first time the next day! I wasn't familiar with the Mydia brand, but it's a world-famous brand. Plus, the price of this 12-seater dishwasher is much cheaper than other well-known brands, which I really like. Both the white and ivory colors are clean, and the two-year warranty means I can use it without worry. I'm still a dishwasher novice, so I read the manual and tried it out. Since it's a 12-seater, my family of four does a lot of dishes a day, and there's plenty of space. The technician said the two-stage washing blades would help with dishwashing. The LED touch-screen controls are simple and easy to use, so I can choose the mode I need. The various wash cycles are also great, so I can choose the one that best suits my needs. The fan drying and automatic door opening functions are great for fast, powerful drying. The night mode is also great for quiet operation in the evenings, which I really like. The product has passed both the EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification, so I can trust and use it safely. My first dishwasher use went very well. It's so nice to see the dishes cleaned so well. ^^ I think I'll be able to enjoy some comfortable free time thanks to the Mydia dishwasher. ^^

Sentence (English): Finally, I received a dishwasher as a gift.
Comments (English): This is a review I wrote after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Team event. I'm a stay-at-home mom for 10 years. Since it's a 12-seater, my family of four does a lot of dishes a day, and there's plenty of space. The technician said the two-stage washing blades would help with dishwashing. The LED touch-screen controls are simple and easy to use, so I can choose the mode I need. The various wash cycles are also great, so I can choose the one that best suits my needs. The fan drying and automatic door opening functions are great for fast, powerful drying. The night mode is also great for quiet operation in the evenings, which I really like. The product has passed both the EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification, so I can trust and use it safely. My first dishwasher use went very well. It's so nice to see the dishes cleaned so well. ^^ I think I'll be able to enjoy some comfortable free time thanks to the Mydia dishwasher. ^^

Comments (English): [ It's so good ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. Initially, I was concerned, "Will it even work in the dishwasher?" and "What about greasy pots and pans?" But after using it, I was so satisfied and comfortable that I wondered why I hadn't bought it sooner. Installation and First Impressions: The first thing that caught my eye when the product arrived was the clean, sophisticated ivory color. It didn't detract from the kitchen's aesthetic, but rather enhanced it. It was a bit larger than a typical dishwasher, but since it's designed for 12 people, I figured it was more than adequate. My first impressions: The first thing I noticed was how powerful it was. It cleaned everything thoroughly, from greasy frying pans and seasoned dishes to dried rice. It felt cleaner and more hygienic than washing dishes by hand. Using dishwasher detergent also helps keep the dishwasher clean and squeaky clean. Best of all, I love the variety of programs available, allowing me to choose the one that best suits my needs. I usually use the regular wash mode, but when I'm pressed for time, I'll use a quick wash in 30 minutes. For days with pots or oily surfaces, I'll use the heavy-duty mode. Plus, there's a timer function, so I can set it to run quietly at night and it's done in no time at all by morning. It's truly a convenient way to spend my time. Noise & Drying Performance: The dishwasher is incredibly quiet. It's not too distracting even when I'm near the kitchen while it's running. If I have the TV on, the sound of the dishwasher is almost completely drowned out. I think even people with sensitive skin can use it without too much trouble. I was also very satisfied with the drying performance. After washing, I opened the dishwasher and the dishes were almost completely dry. Glass cups in particular were spotlessly dry, so I didn't need to wipe them. Of course, plastic containers and the like may have some water droplets due to the nature of the material, but overall, the dishwasher is excellent. Usage Tips: At first, loading dishes was a bit tricky, but after a few tries, you'll get the hang of how to best utilize the space. Large pots on the bottom rack, cups and smaller bowls on the top rack, and it's easy to clean and leaves plenty of space. Another tip: In addition to dishwasher detergent, adding **rinse aid** to your dishwasher will make your glassware shine even brighter. I was secretly satisfied with this. What's disappointing? If I had to pick one, it's that the product is so large that it might be a bit overwhelming in a small kitchen. You should definitely check the space before installing. It's also best to have a professional install it. Do-it-yourself installation is difficult and can lead to leaks or incorrect connections. Overall: What I've noticed after using it is that it's truly improved my quality of life. I've saved the time and energy I used to spend washing dishes, and I can now use that time to have a cup of tea or chat with my family. Cooking is more enjoyable because I can use as many dishes as I want without having to worry about washing them up. It offers excellent value for money, a beautiful design, and excellent cleaning power, so I'm very satisfied with it. If you're considering purchasing a dishwasher, I highly recommend the Mydia 12-seater model! It might feel like an investment at first, but once you actually use it, you'll wonder, "Why did I buy it now?"

Sentence (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Team event.
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Team event. I'm a stay-at-home mom for 10 years. I clean every day, but I've been really loathe to do the dishes lately. People around me who use dishwashers highly recommend it, but I just persevered, determined to do the dishes myself, even if it was a bit of a hassle. I finally got the chance to receive a dishwasher as a gift. ^^ I waited half-heartedly after ordering, but the installer called me quickly and came the next day to install it. The dishwasher was ready in no time. ^^ I had an oven, so I removed it, and the installer even removed the dishwasher lid and installed it perfectly. He even fitted the dishwasher with the mop holder, so I was so grateful. He kindly explained the benefits and how to use the dishwasher, which made me even more satisfied. ^^ My kitchen is on the small side, but the dishwasher fits perfectly, so it's so neat and pretty. ^^ And now for the dishwasher detergent. I ordered it and finally used it for the first time the next day! I wasn't familiar with the Mydia brand, but it's a world-famous brand. Plus, the price of this 12-seater dishwasher is much cheaper than other well-known brands, which I really like. Both the white and ivory colors are clean, and the two-year warranty means I can use it without worry. I'm still a dishwasher novice, so I read the manual before using it. Since it's a 12-seater, my family of four does quite a lot of dishes a day. It's roomy even with all the dishes. The technician said the extra two-stage washing blades would make it even better. The LED touchscreen controls are simple and easy to use, so I love being able to choose the method I need. The various washing cycles are also great, so I can choose the one that best suits my needs. The fan drying and automatic door opening functions are great for fast, powerful drying. The night mode is also great for quieter use at night. I really like it. This product has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification, so I can use it with confidence and safety. My first dishwasher use went very well. It's so nice to see the dishes cleaned so cleanly. I think I'll be able to enjoy some comfortable free time thanks to the Mydia dishwasher in the future.
Comments (Original): 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.▫️▪️마이디어 식기세척기 12인용, 아이보리▪️▫️10년차 전업주부에요. 매일 청소하지만 설거지는정말 너무 하기 싫은 요즘이었어요. 식기세척기 쓰는 주위 지인들은 정말 적극 추천하지만그냥 조금 고생스러워도 설거지 직접하지하며 버티고버티다가 이렇게 좋은 기회로 식기세척기를 선물받게 되었네요^^주문하고도 반신반의하며 기다렸는데 기사님이 빨리 전화주시고, 설치도 다다음날 바로 와서 해주셔서순식간에 식기세척기가 떡허니 자리잡게 되었네요^^오븐장이 있어서 빼내고, 식기세척기 뚜껑빼고 딱 맞춰설치해주시고, 걸레받이까지 딱 맞춰서 완벽하게 설치해주셔서 너무 감사했어요. 식기세척기 장점과 사용법을 친절하게 설명해주시고 가셔서 더더 만족스러웠어요^^주방이 좁은 편인데 식기세척기 딱 맞춰들어오니 너무깔끔하고 이뻐서 기분이 좋네요^^바로 식기세척기 세제주문하고 다음날 드뎌 처음 사용해보았어요!!!저는 마이디어 브랜드를 잘 알지못했는데 세계적으로유명한 브랜드였네요^^거기다 12인용 식기세척기 가격이 유명 브랜드보다 훨씬 저렴해서 너무 맘에 드네요. 화이트, 아이보리 두가지 색상 다 깔끔하네요. 2년 무상보증이라니 걱정없이 사용할수 있을것 같아요. 아직 식세기 초보라 설명서 읽고 사용해보았는데요. 12인용이라 그런지 4인 가족 하루 설거지양 제법 많은데충분히 넣고도 자리가 널널하네요^^기사님 설명으로는 세척날개가 2단으로 추가되어 설거지 더 잘 될거같다고 하셨어요^^LED 터치형 조작부가 간편하고, 알기 쉽게 되어있어필요한 방식 선택해서 사용하면 되니 너무 좋구요. 다양한 세척코스가 있어서 필요에 따라 선택하기도아주 좋은것 같아요^^송풍 건조 및 자동문 열림 기능이 있어서 빠르고, 강력하게 건조할수 있어 좋구요. 야간모드가 있어서저녁에 저소음으로 편하게 이용할수 있어 떠 맘에 드네요^^EMC전자파 적합성 평가와 KC 안전확인도 모두 마친 제품이라고 하니 믿고, 안전하게 사용할수 있을것 같아요. 첫 식세기 사용 아주 잘 마쳤구요. 깨끗하게 세척된 그릇들 보니 너무 좋네요^^앞으로 마이디어 식세기 덕분에 편한 여유시간 가질수 있을것 같아요^^

Sentence (English): This is a review I wrote after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): [ It's so good ] || ---------------- || This is a review I wrote after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. Initially, I was concerned, "Will it even work in the dishwasher?" and "What about greasy pots and pans?" But after using it, I was so satisfied and comfortable that I wondered why I hadn't bought it sooner. Installation and First Impressions: The first thing I noticed when the product arrived was the clean, sophisticated ivory color. It didn't detract from the kitchen's aesthetic, but rather enhanced it. It was a bit larger than a typical dishwasher, but I figured it was more than adequate for a 12-person kitchen. The installation was completed by a professional technician in about 30 minutes. They also safely connected the water, electricity, and drainage, so I had no worries. Impressions from Use: The first thing I noticed was how powerful the dishwasher was. It cleaned everything thoroughly, from greasy frying pans and seasoned dishes to dried rice. It felt cleaner and more hygienic than washing dishes by hand. Using dishwasher detergent also helps keep the dishwasher clean and leaves no stains. Best of all, I love the variety of programs, allowing me to choose the one that best suits my needs. I usually use the regular wash mode, but when I'm pressed for time, I'll do a quick wash in 30 minutes. For days with pots or oily surfaces, I'll use the heavy-duty mode. Plus, there's a timer function, so I can set it to run quietly at night and it's done in no time at all by morning. It's a real convenience. Noise and drying performance: The dishwasher is incredibly quiet. It's not too bothersome even when I'm near the kitchen while it's running. If I have the TV on, the sound of the dishwasher is almost completely drowned out. I think even people with sensitive skin can use it without too much trouble. I was also very satisfied with the drying performance. After washing, I opened the dishwasher and the dishes were practically dry. Glass cups in particular were spotlessly dry, so I didn't need to wipe them. Of course, plastic containers might have some water droplets due to the nature of the material, but overall, the dishwasher is excellent. Tips for use: At first, loading dishes was a bit tricky, but after a few tries, I got the hang of how to best utilize the space. Large pots on the bottom rack, cups and smaller bowls on the top rack, and it cleaned up easily and left plenty of space. Another tip: adding **rinse aid** in addition to dishwasher detergent will make your glassware shine even brighter. I was secretly satisfied with this. What's the downside? If I had to pick one, it's that the product is so large that it can be a bit overwhelming in a small kitchen. You should definitely check the space before installing. Also, it's best to have a professional install it. Doing it yourself is difficult and can lead to leaks or incorrect connections. Overall, what I've noticed after using it is that it's truly improved my quality of life. I've saved the time and energy I used to spend washing dishes, and I can now enjoy a cup of tea or chatting with my family. Cooking is more enjoyable because I can use as many dishes as I want without having to worry about washing them. It offers excellent value for money, a beautiful design, and excellent cleaning power, so I'm very satisfied with it. Comments (English): [ It's so good ] || ---------------- || This is a review I wrote after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. But after using it, I was so satisfied and comfortable that I wondered why I hadn't bought it sooner. Installation and First Impressions: The first thing I noticed when the product arrived was the clean, sophisticated ivory color. It didn't detract from the kitchen's aesthetic, but rather enhanced it. It was a bit larger than a typical dishwasher, but I figured it was more than adequate for a 12-person kitchen. The installation was completed by a professional technician in about 30 minutes. They also safely connected the water, electricity, and drainage, so I had no worries. Impressions from Use: The first thing I noticed was how powerful the dishwasher was. It cleaned everything thoroughly, from greasy frying pans and seasoned dishes to dried rice. It felt cleaner and more hygienic than washing dishes by hand. Using dishwasher detergent also helps keep the dishwasher clean and leaves no stains. Best of all, I love the variety of programs, allowing me to choose the one that best suits my needs. I usually use the regular wash mode, but when I'm pressed for time, I'll do a quick wash in 30 minutes. For days with pots or oily surfaces, I'll use the heavy-duty mode. Plus, there's a timer function, so I can set it to run quietly at night and it's done in no time at all by morning. It's a real convenience. Noise and drying performance: The dishwasher is incredibly quiet. It's not too bothersome even when I'm near the kitchen while it's running. If I have the TV on, the sound of the dishwasher is almost completely drowned out. I think even people with sensitive skin can use it without too much trouble. I was also very satisfied with the drying performance. After washing, I opened the dishwasher and the dishes were practically dry. Glass cups in particular were spotlessly dry, so I didn't need to wipe them. Of course, plastic containers might have some water droplets due to the nature of the material, but overall, the dishwasher is excellent. Tips for use: At first, loading dishes was a bit tricky, but after a few tries, I got the hang of how to best utilize the space. Large pots on the bottom rack, cups and smaller bowls on the top rack, and it cleaned up easily and left plenty of space. Another tip: adding **rinse aid** in addition to dishwasher detergent will make your glassware shine even brighter. I was secretly satisfied with this. What's the downside? If I had to pick one, it's that the product is so large that it can be a bit overwhelming in a small kitchen. You should definitely check the space before installing. Also, it's best to have a professional install it. Doing it yourself is difficult and can lead to leaks or incorrect connections. Overall, what I've noticed after using it is that it's truly improved my quality of life. I've saved the time and energy I used to spend washing dishes, and I can now enjoy a cup of tea or chatting with my family. Cooking is more enjoyable because I can use as many dishes as I want without having to worry about washing them. It offers excellent value for money, a beautiful design, and excellent cleaning power, so I'm very satisfied with it. If you're considering purchasing a dishwasher, I highly recommend the Mydia 12-seater model! It might feel like an investment at first, but once you actually use it, you'll wonder, "Why did I buy it now?"

Sentence (English): As a family of five, washing dishes was really tough, but this dishwasher is fantastic.
Comments (English): As a family of five, washing dishes was really tough, but this dishwasher is fantastic. The technician was incredibly kind from start to finish and provided excellent consultation. The cabinet was longer than the dishwasher, so they added extra finishing work. Since we needed space for the door to open, they installed it with a gap. Because it was installed at the very end of the cabinet, they did extra reinforcement work. ^^ Although the installation cost was higher, it was worth it. My dishwashing time has drastically decreased, and my body feels so much more at ease. The dishwasher, Roborock, and dryer are the best! I even threw away the drying rack that used to take up so much space. The sink looks so neat now. It’s so convenient and great to be able to store dishes immediately once they dry. ^^ If you are considering buying one, I highly recommend it! I am so satisfied that the time I spent hesitating feels like a waste. Buying such a convenient product at this price is the best choice. Since we use a lot of dishes, cups, pots, etc., I feel even more strongly that we made the right purchase. The 5-person capacity is sufficient for a 12-person load. Quite a lot fits inside. Additional note after use: After setting it to just the basic wash cycle, I poured water into a cup and noticed some foam rising. It seemed like it wasn't rinsed thoroughly enough. So, I ran it with an extra rinse cycle, and the foam almost completely disappeared. I used tablet detergent, and even when I do the dishes myself, I pay close attention to rinsing because I'm thinking of my family and children. For those like me, it might vary depending on the detergent, but try pouring water into a cup from a distance after the dishwasher finishes. Since I use a water purifier, I noticed that if I place the cup underneath and press the button, a lot of foam rises to the cup when the rinse wasn't done well, but when it was done properly, no foam rises even if I pour water using the same method. Although it adds more time, I think it's better to use it with 1-2 extra rinses for the sake of health. Tetris was the only game I liked back in school, and while my husband says stacking is harder, I enjoy Tetris, so I use it every day and am having fun. The results show that it cleans well and is great. There might be some water pooling in deep dishes. Also, when I had it installed, the technician mentioned that limescale is unavoidable in Korean faucets and recommended using the water softening function. I use a water softener with salt, and since I heard rinse aid contains chemicals, I think tablet detergent is slightly better, so I am currently using just one tablet. For the dishwasher drum clean, I think running it once a month with citric acid will also help remove limescale.

Because it was installed at the very end of the cabinet, they did extra reinforcement work. ^^ Although the installation cost was higher, it was worth it. My dishwashing time has drastically decreased, and my body feels so much more at ease. The dishwasher, Roborock, and dryer are the best! I even threw away the drying rack that used to take up so much space. The sink looks so neat now. I am so satisfied that the time I spent hesitating feels like a waste. Buying such a convenient product at this price is the best choice. Although it adds more time, I think it's better to use it with 1-2 extra rinses for the sake of health. Tetris was the only game I liked back in school, and while my husband says stacking is harder, I enjoy Tetris, so I use it every day and am having fun. The results show that it cleans well and is great. There might be some water pooling in deep dishes. Also, when I had it installed, the technician mentioned that limescale is unavoidable in Korean faucets and recommended using the water softening function. I use a water softener with salt, and since I heard rinse aid contains chemicals, I think tablet detergent is slightly better, so I am currently using just one tablet. For the dishwasher drum clean, I think running it once a month with citric acid will also help remove limescale.

Sentence (English): I am so satisfied that the time I spent hesitating feels like a waste.

I am so satisfied that the time I spent hesitating feels like a waste. Buying such a convenient product at this price is the best choice. For the dishwasher drum clean, I think running it once a month with citric acid will also help remove limescale.

Comments (English): As a family of five, washing dishes was really tough, but this dishwasher is fantastic. The technician was incredibly kind from start to finish and provided excellent consultation. The cabinet was longer than the dishwasher, so they added extra finishing work. Since we needed space for the door to open, they installed it with a gap. Because it was installed at the very end of the cabinet, they did extra reinforcement work. ^^ Although the installation cost was higher, it was worth it. My dishwashing time has drastically decreased, and my body feels so much more at ease. The dishwasher, Roborock, and dryer are the best! I even threw away the drying rack that used to take up so much space. The sink looks so neat now. It’s so convenient and great to be able to store dishes immediately once they dry. ^^ If you are considering buying one, I highly recommend it! I am so satisfied that the time I spent hesitating feels like a waste. Buying such a convenient product at this price is the best choice. Since we use a lot of dishes, cups, pots, etc., I feel even more strongly that we made the right purchase. The 5-person capacity is sufficient for a 12-person load. Quite a lot fits inside. Additional note after use: After setting it to just the basic wash cycle, I poured water into a cup and noticed some foam rising. It seemed like it wasn't rinsed thoroughly enough. So, I ran it with an extra rinse cycle, and the foam almost completely disappeared. I used tablet detergent, and even when I do the dishes myself, I pay close attention to rinsing because I'm thinking of my family and children. For those like me, it might vary depending on the detergent, but try pouring water into a cup from a distance after the dishwasher finishes. Since I use a water purifier, I noticed that if I place the cup underneath and press the button, a lot of foam rises to the cup when the rinse wasn't done well, but when it was done properly, no foam rises even if I pour water using the same method. Although it adds more time, I think it's better to use it with 1-2 extra rinses for the sake of health. Tetris was the only game I liked back in school, and while my husband says stacking is harder, I enjoy Tetris, so I use it every day and am having fun. The results show that it cleans well and is great. There might be some water pooling in deep dishes. Also, when I had it installed, the technician mentioned that limescale is unavoidable in Korean faucets and recommended using the water softening function. I use a water softener with salt, and since I heard rinse aid contains chemicals, I think tablet detergent is slightly better, so I am currently using just one tablet. For the dishwasher drum clean, I think running it once a month with citric acid will also help remove limescale.

Sentence (English): It works and dries very well (compared to our previous dishwasher, which we were very happy with, a luxury).

Sentence (English): The racks for this dishwasher clearly were designed by someone who has never used one.
Comments (English): [ Don't, just don't ] || ---------------- || The racks for this dishwasher clearly were designed by someone who has never used one. The tines are too close together - only 3/4 between those for dinner plates - so close that I had to buy new dishes. All tines in both racks are angled, making it impossible to fit bowls in without wasting space. My good wine glasses don't fit this machine at all, the cheap ones just barely. Sentence (English): My house has a 2-person dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ My own money, my own dishwasher review~! ] || ---------------- || My house has a 2-person dishwasher. My sister, who is preparing to move, came to visit us and tried it out. She asked me to buy her a dishwasher as a housewarming gift, so I bought it. When I personally used the dishwasher, refrigerator, and dryer, I thought the bigger the better. I live alone, but I wanted a bigger dishwasher. I thought my sister would think the same way later, so I ordered a 6-person one in advance. My boyfriend's mother is using this Samsung Bespoke product herself. She recommended it to me, saying that it has been used for about 2 years and is still sturdy without any problems. She said that the interior is wider than other brands' 6-person dishwashers, so even small frying pans and gas hoods can be removed and washed.^^ The interior of the dishwasher is also made of stainless steel, so the noise from the high-pressure water hitting the wall when the dishwasher is in operation is less than the product in our house. The filter mesh can be easily removed and washed, and since it is washed with high-temperature water, even oily dishes are washed cleanly. My sister's family has a baby, so they don't use a rinser. It dries, but my boyfriend's mom said that if you put a rinse aid in and dry it, the dishes will shine and dry faster. After using it for about a month, the inside of the dishwasher may start to smell musty. In that case, you can use a dishwasher interior cleaning cloth, or mix citric acid powder with vinegar in water and wash it. The smell will completely disappear. The dishwasher at my house does not have an automatic door open function, but Samsung Bespoke products have an automatic door open function. I'm so jealous that after breakfast, I can just press one button and go out and it will dry by the time I get off work. I want to buy a house soon and switch to a Samsung product.
Comments (Original): [ 내돈 내산 식기세척기 후기~!! ] || ---------------- || 저희집에는 2인용 식기세척기가 있는데, 이사 준비중인 언니가 저희 집에 놀러왔다가 한번써보고는 집들이 선물로 식기세척기를 사달라고 하길래 구매했어요  식기세척기, 냉장고, 건조기는 직접 써보니 크면 클수록 좋더라구요  저는 1인 가구 인데도 식기세척기가 더 컸으면 좋겠는데, 저희 언니도 나중에 그런 생각을 할것같아서 미리미리 6인용으로 시켜줬습니다 ㅎ  이 삼성 비스포크 제품은 남자친구네 엄마가 직접 쓰고 계시는데, 2년정도 썼는데 아직 문제없이 튼튼하다며 추천해주신 제품이에요  다른 브랜드의 똑같은 6인용 식기세척기 보다 내부가 넓게 나와서 작은 후라이팬이나 가스 후드기도 분리 후 세척이 가능하다고 말씀해 주셨어요^^  식기세척기 내부도 스텐으로 되어있어서 세척기 작동시 고압수가 벽면에 부딪힐때 나는 소음도 저희 집 제품보다 적네요  필터 거름망도 다 손쉽게 분리해서 세척할 수 있고, 고온수로 세척이 되니 기름범벅인 접시도 깔끔히 세척되네요ㅎㅎ  언니네는 애기가 있어서 린스기를 사용 안하고 건조시키지만, 남자친구 엄마네는 린스기 넣고 건조시키면 접시에 광택이나며 더 빨리 건조된다고 하네요~ 한달정도 쓰다보면 식기세척기 내부에서 쿰쿰한 냄새가 날 수 있는데, 그럴때는 식기세척기 내부 청소포를 이용하셔도 되고, 구연산가루를 식초와 함께 물에  타서 세척해주면 냄새가 싹 사라져요  저희 집 식기세척기는 자동문열림 기능이 없는데, 삼성 비스포크 제품은 자동 문열림 기능덕분에 아침 밥 먹고 버튼하나만 눌러놓고 나가면 퇴근할때 까지 알아서 건조된다고 하니 너무 부럽네요  저도 빨리 집 장만해서 삼성 제품으로 갈아타고 싶네요

Comments (English): [ I highly recommend this dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || When I wash dishes for a long time, my back, shoulders, and arms hurt everywhere. And the automatic door opening after the hot air drying is perfect. You might say it's small for 6 people, but we are a family of 4 with two children in middle and high school. I don't put things like cups (plastic, stickers made of melting material, tumblers, frying pans) in the dishwasher because they are not recommended. Pots are bulky and just take up space, so I just wash one or two. If it usually takes 30 minutes to wash the dishes, it's done in 5 minutes after putting them in the dishwasher. The remaining time is great for sitting on the sofa, drinking a cup of tea, and enjoying leisure. Even though there is a large size for 14 people, many people use the 6-person size as a sub, so if you don't have one, I recommend starting with the small one.

Sentence (English): After 17 years of trouble-free operation, our old Bosch dishwasher stopped working.
Comments (English): [ My new Bosch dishwasher ] || ---------------- || After 17 years of trouble-free operation, our old Bosch dishwasher stopped working. A dishwasher from this company seemed like a natural choice. After using it for over a week, it turned out to be the right choice. The SPS4HMW49E dishwasher is 45 cm wide, which meant that it easily fit in the place of the old one. After switching it on, we were greeted by a clear display with a pleasant color. A pleasant surprise was the very quiet operation and the multitude of programs. The cutlery drawer, unlike the basket in our old Bosch, turned out to be much more convenient and made washing easier. Despite the fact that I used traditional "all in one" tablets, the dishes were washed and shiny. The only downside was the need to manually open the dishwasher door to dry the dishes. The most important advantage of this dishwasher for me is the possibility of connecting it to hot water, which is how I use it. The water is heated by solar panels and at the limit of 60 degrees it works fine. I recommend it.
Comments (Original): [ Moja nowa zmywarka Bosch ] || ---------------- || Po 17 latach bezawaryjnej pracy nasza stara zmywarka Bosch przestała działać. Naturalnym wyborem wydawała się również zmywarka od tej firmy. Po ponad tygodniowym użytkowaniu okazało się to słusznym wyborem. Zmywarka SPS4HMW49E ma 45 cm szerokości co sprawiło że bez problemów zmieściła się w miejsce starej. Po włączeniu przywitał nas czytelny wyświetlacz o przyjemnym kolorze. Miłym zaskoczeniem była bardzo cicha praca i mnogość programów. Szuflada na sztućce w odróżnieniu od koszyczka w naszym starym Boschu okazała się o wiele wygodniejsza i powodująca lepsze domywanie. Pomimo tego że użyłem tradycyjnych tabletek 'wszystko w jednym' naczynia były umyte i lśniące. Jedynym minusem była ręcznego konieczność ręcznego otwarcia drzwiczek zmywarki w celu dosuszenia naczyń. Najważniejszą dla mnie zaletą tej zmywarki jest możliwość podłączenia do ciepłej wody, w takiej opcji ją użytkuję. Woda jest ogrzewana przez panele słoneczne i przy granicznych 60 stopniach daje radę. Polecam.

Sentence (English): Years ago we formed a habit of "pre-cleaning" our dishes before putting them in our dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Super glad we bought this dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Years ago we formed a habit of "pre-cleaning" our dishes before putting them in our dishwasher. We'd let them soak, give them a brushing and then, when they "looked" clean, we'd put them in the unit. After we bought this unit, to see how well it would clean, we decided to just put our dishes into the unit immediately after each meal, dried detritus and all (after scraping large leftover food scraps into the trash, of course). Even though we never use a rinse cycle between complete washings, and sometimes it is 2-3 days before we start a wash, the dishes still come out clean as a whistle after a complete wash. We were pretty surprised. Admittedly we still sometimes unintentionally fall back into our old habit, especially if there is a lot of dried residue on the plates, but even when we don't they still come out super clean.PROS - more and better racks (3), adjustable rack heights (but not on bottom rack), a cool new top rack "top and bottom" spray process that really works better (spinning tubes with holes in them), it is very quiet, and it REALLY works. Also, this unit has a catch tray underneath for leaks from the fill valve where a sensor is that will shut off the unit if it catches water (nice, since we have hardwood floors in the kitchen).CONS - Unfortunately, having three racks in the same amount of under-cabinet space means that the bottom rack has to be lower. We now have to bend over a little farther to load it, so if you have back trouble (which we do not) that could be a factor. Also, our silverware handles are slightly larger than many of the holes in the lid of the utensil caddy, so we do not use the lids on half of it, but that doesn't seem to affect the cleaning action at all, and after all, loading the utensils is quicker if you do not have to pay attention to exactly where each spoon, fork, or knife will "fit".

I've been keeping the dishwasher in my shopping cart for a while, and honestly, I was a bit suspicious of it, and there were even rumors that I shouldn't wash it beforehand and that it's a bit annoying, but I just didn't wash it beforehand and just put the food in and put it in the dishwasher and turned it on. Was it because the detergent was good? It cleaned well without any oil, rice paste, or seasoning? And if you put too many dishes in and put it in so that the washing wings underneath don't turn, it won't clean well. There needs to be some gaps to clean it well. If you do it too tightly, seasoning can get stuck. I didn't wash it beforehand and just put the food in and put it in the dishwasher and turned it on. As you can see in the picture, there's not a single grain of food stuck on it, right? The tongs underneath are for grilling fish, so the fish was a bit hard on it, but it was completely cleaned. I'm completely satisfied. I still don't wash it beforehand. I put it in the dishwasher and turn it on right after I finish eating. If it's a bit heavy, use strong, if it's normal, use standard, and if it's a bit light, just use fast. Before using, don't say it's inconvenient, and please look up information carefully and read the user manual carefully before using it~ It cleans better than just doing it by hand. There's no problem with the machine. If it doesn't clean well, put in some detergent and run it. If you put too much in because you're wasting space and run it, it won't clean well~ There's a high chance that seasoning will stick, so please use it while thinking about the principle of the dishwasher. If you place it so that the water stream touches the dishwasher's rotating blades and run it, you'll have shiny, spotless dishes! I used it after reading the user manual thoroughly before using it. I have a water purifier line, so it's very convenient to use the installed type. However, if you don't block the non-installed water inlet, it will leak. I didn't know about the plug and threw it away, so I blocked it with a random plug, but if you're installing it, be sure to block the non-installed water inlet with a plug. It will leak. And don't expect it to dry. It doesn't dry well. Ceramics dry with rinse, but other dishes don't dry well. Nevertheless, when I think about the purpose of dishwashing, it's so great that I like it~ I hate washing dishes so much, but I'm liberated. I feel catharsis looking at the clean dishes. And I used to cook a lot, but I felt a bit tired after cleaning up and washing dishes, but that fatigue has been greatly reduced thanks to the dishwasher. In addition, the seasoning on the delivery food bowls really comes off. I personally eat a lot of side dishes and often cook fried foods, but I feel a lot less burdened now. I'm really worried about wiping off the oil, and I don't have to worry about washing it several times! And this control panel is relatively intuitive, so it's easy to operate~ As for the noise, I think it's okay for me. If you're sensitive to sound, you might feel it's loud. I use a capsule + powder detergent and a powder detergent as an auxiliary detergent. I hope the review helps you make a purchase. If the review was helpful, please help me. Thank you for reading.

After a while, if you just make sure the dishes are placed correctly, they will dry well without any problems. I put the plastic on the side where the hot air dryer comes out inside the dishwasher and it got deformed. LG says the temperature is higher, but I don't think it needs to be higher. Be careful! The price varies every day. I think it would be better to put it in your shopping cart with a card discount or self-discount coupon and check the price before purchasing!

Comments (English): The dishwasher is one of the things I have to bring in, and I also have a dryer, but I had a lot of concerns about space and other issues. Everyone said it was a big deal, so I worried again and time passed and we just negotiated. My husband wanted to buy a big one, but to put a big one in, I had to remove a door below and make space, but there wasn't a good place to put a refrigerator, so we negotiated to put it next to the sink for 6 people. I like a big deal, so I'm not 100% satisfied, but I liked it. The design seems similar to S* Magic and Sam*. They're not the same, but they're similar. Still, I'm satisfied with the white color, design, and the fact that it's easy to clean and has an automatic door-opening function, and I'm satisfied. I'm using a small detergent. The downside is that a pot doesn't fit. It's two-tiered, so dishes, spoons, knives, etc. fit, but cutting boards and pots are limited. The size is why I use this for washing dishes, but I don't hate washing dishes. I think it became more convenient because I finished the rest quickly after putting in the dishwasher and putting it away. If you really want convenience, you should buy a bigger one. Oh, and I put it in my shopping cart and thought about it for a few days, but the price went up and it didn't go down, so I bought it when it was the most expensive. And after using it for a few months, I saw that there was metal-colored material on the top plate on both sides of the door, so I tried to clean it, but it didn't come off well, so I rubbed it hard and looked closely, and it seemed that the metal color had leaked from the part that was slightly exposed and touched the bottom where it opened, maybe because it's a product that flows water. Since there's no mention of this in other reviews, I think I'll have to wait a few more days and think about whether to contact customer service.

Sentence (English): I had a lot of concerns about the dishwasher and dryer, but I also had a lot of concerns about space and other issues.
Comments (English): I had a lot of concerns about the dishwasher and dryer, but I also had a lot of concerns about space and other issues. Everyone said it was a good size, so I worried again and time passed and we just negotiated. My husband wanted to buy a big one, but to put a big one in, we had to take off a door and make space, but there wasn't a good place to put a refrigerator, so we negotiated to put it next to the sink for 6 people. I like a good size, so I'm not 100% satisfied, but I liked it. The design is similar to S* Magic and Sam*. It's not the same, but it's similar. It would be better to compare it by measuring the width, height, etc. by placing it in front of you and looking at it in cm. However, it's not sold at the same store. Still, I'm satisfied with the white color and design, and I'm satisfied with the fact that it's easy to wash and has an automatic door opening function. I'm using a small detergent. The downside is that it doesn't fit a pot. It's two-tiered, so you can fit dishes, spoons, knives, etc., but cutting boards and pots are limited. That's why this is good for washing dishes. I don't hate doing dishes, so I put them in the dishwasher and quickly finished the remaining dishes, so I think it became more convenient. If you really want convenience, you have to buy a big one. Oh, and I put it in my shopping cart and thought about it for a few days, but the price went up and didn't go down, so I bought it when it was the most expensive. It went down right after I bought it? That was a shame. And after using it for a few months, I saw a metal-colored surface on both sides of the door, so I tried to wipe it, but it didn't come off well, so I rubbed it hard and looked closely, and it seemed like the metal color had leaked from the slightly exposed part that touches the bottom of the door because it's a product that flows water. Since there's no mention of this in other reviews, I think I'll have to wait a few more days and think about whether to contact customer service.

Sentence (English): I was one of those aunts who insisted we needed a dishwasher, just like with a dryer.
Comments (English): I was one of those aunts who insisted we needed a dishwasher, just like with a dryer. I knew the need, but I was really worried about space and other issues. Everyone said "the bigger, the better," so I hesitated even more. Time passed, and we just reached an agreement. My husband wanted a large one, but to fit a big one, we would have had to remove a bottom door to make space, and since there wasn't really a suitable spot for side dishes, we agreed to go with the 6-person model that sits next to the sink. Since I prefer bigger, I'm not 100% satisfied with it, but I liked it. The design seems similar to S*Magic or Samsung. Not exactly the same, but similar. It would have been better to lay them out in front and measure the width, height, and depth to compare them, but they aren't products sold in the same store. Still, I am satisfied with the white color and design. I also like the automatic door opening feature after washing. I am using the small size detergent. The downside is that pots don't fit. Since it is a two-tier design, dishes, cutlery, and knives fit, but cutting boards and pots are limited by the size. So, regarding dishwashing, since I don't really hate it, I pre-wash the dishes, put them in the dishwasher, and quickly finish up the rest, so I think it has become more convenient. If you want complete convenience, the bigger the better, so you should buy the largest one. Oh, and I had it in my cart and debated for days, so the price went up and didn't drop, so I ended up buying it when it was at its highest. The price dropped right after I bought it, though. That was a shame. Also, after using it for a few months, I noticed a metallic stain on the top surface on both sides of the door. I tried wiping it, but it didn't come off well, so I scrubbed it hard. Upon closer inspection, perhaps because it is a product where water flows, it seems the metallic color leaked from the part that touches the bottom when opening and is slightly exposed. Since no one else mentioned this in the reviews, I think I need to observe it for a few more days and decide whether to contact customer service.

Sentence (English): Everyone said "the bigger, the better," so I hesitated even more.

Sentence (English): Dishwashers are expensive, and I used to think they only came in built-in models.
Comments (English): [ great ] || ---------------- || Dishwashers are expensive, and I used to think they only came in built-in models. However, I recently discovered that 6-place setting dishwashers exist, so I did some research and purchased one. The Samsung Bespoke comes with glass, which is beautiful and sleek. I debated the color but chose white; I heard it is their best-selling model. After ordering, a technician called to schedule a time and came over. They were kind and explained everything well. I was worried after seeing reviews saying the sound of the water draining was loud, but I didn't find it particularly noisy. The buttons are easy to use and not difficult at all. The sound of the water is soft and doesn't disturb me at all while I'm in the living room. Even on the Quick cycle, it takes about 30 minutes and removes grease effectively. The Standard cycle is more thorough at 1 hour and 8 minutes, though a lot of water does remain after it finishes. The door opens, and the residual heat dries out the rest of the moisture. The Powerful Heat Dryer is much more expensive, but even without it, if you just open the door wide after a while, the dishes dry completely. Also, if you place dishes upside down, water collects in the indented area at the top, so it is better to load them diagonally. I like that the door opens automatically when it finishes. When I came back from going out, the door was already open. I was just sitting there, so I was a bit startled by the sound of it opening. I use the automatic opening feature on my Samsung washing machine and dryer as well, and I was satisfied with that; it's the best because it uses the same method. As long as you do a quick pre-wash and arrange the items well, it cleans everything perfectly, so I am truly satisfied. Since I have back pain, I am even more satisfied because I can handle everything while standing. It is a bit big, but it is pretty. I really needed a dishwasher because I used to do the dishes twice a day—lunch and dinner—for both my child and my husband. It is convenient because I can run baby food plus bottles all at once, and it sterilizes everything. Thanks to the dishwasher, I have time to spare, which is great. I highly recommend it. It is a whole new world; I am truly amazed. Thank you.

Comments (English): (#PhotoReviewEventParticipation). After much thought about the LG DUE6BGL2E model that I chose based on the kitchen structure, I think I made a really good purchase. I am also satisfied with the product performance. I usually do the dishes very thoroughly, so I wondered if there would be a difference, but it was washed so cleanly that the glasses were shiny. Stainless steel dishes also dried fluffily without water marks, and when I set the drying option to 60 minutes, it dried well with almost no moisture. My daily life of washing dishes has become really convenient. Now I have more time after meals, and my hands are less sore, so I'm very satisfied. I confidently recommend it to those who are considering an LG dishwasher!
Comments (Original): (#포토리뷰이벤트참여)주방 구조에 맞춰 고민 끝에 선택한 LG DUE6BGL2E 모델, 결과적으로 정말 잘 샀다고 생각해요.제품 성능도 만족스러워요.저는 평소에 애벌을 아주 꼼꼼하게 하는 편이라 과연 차이가 있을까 했는데, 유리잔이 반짝반짝 윤이 날 정도로 깔끔하게 세척됩니다.스테인리스 식기도 물자국 없이 뽀송하게 마르는데, 건조 옵션을 60분으로 설정하면 거의 물기 없이 잘 마르더라고요.프로쉬 타블렛을 사용하는데, 1시간 코스에서는 가끔 덜 녹아서 지금은 ‘일반 코스(표준)’로만 사용 중이에요.시간은 조금 길지만, 그만큼 깔끔하고 잔여물 없이 마무리되는 게 마음에 들어요.무엇보다 디자인도 군더더기 없이 예쁘고, 주방에 고급스러운 느낌을 더해줍니다.설거지로 지치던 일상이 진짜 편해졌어요. 이젠 식사 후에도 여유가 생기고, 손도 덜 상해서 너무 만족하고 있어요.LG 식기세척기 고민 중이신 분들께 자신 있게 추천합니다!

Sentence (English): The dishwasher we purchased has proven to be a very good product.
Comments (English): [ very good product ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher we purchased has proven to be a very good product. It has several positive points worth highlighting, such as its spaciousness and the well-arranged cutlery compartments, which allow for many items to be washed at once. Another notable aspect, linked to the first, is the upper cutlery tray. It not only leaves more space in the lower compartment where dishes are normally placed, but also allows the cutlery to be arranged neatly and evenly spaced, making it optimally clean. We also liked how effective it is with pans and baking sheets. We used to always wash them, but now the dishwasher takes care of them. They come out perfectly. The automatic door opening after washing is also a great success, contributing to the drying and good finish of the dishes. We are truly satisfied with the purchase; the brand has not disappointed us at all.
Comments (Original): [ muy buen producto ] || ---------------- || El lavavajillas que compramos ha resultado muy buen producto. Otro aspecto a destacar, ligado al primero, es la bandeja superior para cubiertos, no solo deja más espacio en el compartimento inferior dónde normalmente se colocan los castillos, sino que permite colocar muy bien y espaciados los cubiertos por lo que su limpieza es óptima. También nos ha gustado la gran efectividad con sartenes y bandejas de horno. Antes siempre las fregábamos y ahora se ocupa el lavavajillas. Salen estupendamente. La apertura automática de la puerta tras el lavado también nos parece un acierto, contribuye al secado y al buen acabado de las piezas. Estamos realmente satisfechos con la compra, la marca no nos ha defraudado en absoluto.

Sentence (English): Install was easy as it's a standard size.
Comments (English): [ cleans well and super quiet. No idea why it has wifi. ] || ---------------- || Install was easy as it's a standard size. It came with everything needed: discharge hose, connection hose, screws. Once we started a cycle we noticed how quiet it is vs our previous dishwasher. I recorded about 10 minutes of the dishwasher running and the decibel meter was around 40-70 decibels. With an average around 40 decibels. It's easy to let it run and not really know it's going. The racks handle most of our dishes, with the exception of really tall plates - like a serving platter. The top rack can be adjusted to go higher or lower, so that allows for taller things at the bottom. However, it is at the expense of the upper rack. The 3rd rack at the top is great for silverware. Much easier to empty than the basket. But, it does also comes with a basket. At first I was concerned that the handle sticking out would be problematic, but it doesn't stick out very far with our 26" deep counter. Our dishes come out clean and mostly dry. The dishwasher itself however does seem to stay damp after it has been run. So far this has not been a problem. But, if you were to run, empty and leave for a while, I could see it getting moldy. We did hook to wifi and hook to the LG app on our phone, it was fun to play with, but honestly not useful at all. I would way rather have a tall tub and forgo the wifi. Seems like it's technology just for technology sake. We did run the dishwasher without it connected to wifi and it seems fine without.The front stainless does not seem to pickup fingerprints and after 2 months it still looks clean.The readout on the top of the door is my only complaint. We have to bend down and peer through the "crack" to see how much time is left on a cycle. Seems like it would have been better to put the timer on a led in the front of the dishwasher.

Sentence (English): I chose this dishwasher after the high-end product i owned had a problem and i was unable to get any repair person to come service it because i live too far from a big city and the brand (Hestan rebranded Smeg) was too unfamiliar to the local appliance repair.
Comments (English): [ Good Quality for the Price and Quiet! ] || ---------------- || I chose this dishwasher after the high-end product i owned had a problem and i was unable to get any repair person to come service it because i live too far from a big city and the brand (Hestan rebranded Smeg) was too unfamiliar to the local appliance repair. I mention this as context for review. this dishwasher was selected for the door-open feature, the quiet level, and the ability to clean, and the 3 level rack. I find the door-open feature so valuable that it is hard to imagine not every machine has it as an option. i start the machine after dinner, it is quiet enough to watch a movie or converse in the open-concept area. when i wake the next morning, the dishes are much dryer when using the door-open feature than when i do not use it. It cleans well and has the water stop feature that Smeg/Hestan also has which will prevent a full leak if it detects a leak. my former machine also had the light inside. only the 800 series offers this and it did not offer the door-open. my hubby, who is as low-tech as they come (he would be happy without a dishwasher at all and just do it by hand) commented on how much he loves the interior light in the old dishwasher. i really wish both light and door-open features were available in the same machine. so, here is the challenge that makes this 4 and not 5 stars. after living with the heft and hand-feel of the Hestan/Smeg racks, it is really hard to get use to these flimsy racks. the bottom rack is easily pulled off the track, so to speak, and we both find it going off-track and catywhompas when the bottom rack is pulled out to unload. Aunque ese programa tarda bastante, lo dejamos puesto por la noche, ya que no hace ruido apenas y, como comentaba, al terminar se abre la puerta sola para contribuir al secado.El segundo aspecto que nos ha gustado es la tercera bandeja para cubiertos. En nuestro antiguo lavavajillas no la teníamos y es un elemento que se agradece, ya que aumenta el espacio considerablemente.El último aspecto que nos ha sorprendido es la app que se conecta al lavavajillas. Pensabamos que ni la ibamos a usar y la verdad es que es sencilla y ofrece información útil.Así que en general, muy satisfechos

Sentence (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Mydia 12-person dishwasher I had been using a 4-person dishwasher, but it was too small and narrow, so I was looking for a bigger one, and luckily I was able to use a 12-person dishwasher. The manufacturer is in China, but Coupang imports it and Coupang also handles after-sales service, so I think I can use it with confidence. Design, size It is neat and pretty with a white color and black touch panel. The size is 598mm in width, 600mm in back width, and 845mm in height, so it is large as expected for 12 people. Although the width is suitable for installing it in my sink, it does not fit because of the height and depth. So I couldn't install it in the sink and installed it alone behind the sink faucet. The exhaust hose connected to the product was not as short as I thought, so the product was behind the sink, but I was able to connect it to the pipe under the sink. Internal structure The interior is composed of three stages, so the first stage can easily hold large dishes such as large plates and frying pans. The second level can hold small and medium-sized dishes such as rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates, and the top level can hold spoons, knives, and scissors. I was worried that it would be difficult to wash because it overlapped too much, but each tray has a nozzle that comes out of the water, and it sprays strongly from the top to the bottom, so the washing power is excellent. The front panel of the function is very easy to operate because the necessary operations are displayed right away. It seems that the washing power is even better because it goes up to 90 degrees when washing at high temperature. There are up and down buttons, so you can wash dishes only at the top or bottom when necessary. - You can understand all the functions just by the letters on the function buttons. ^^ It also shows the remaining time, so you can tell right away when it's finished, and when it's finished, the door on the front opens slightly. So the heat and moisture inside are blown away. The small dishwasher I used didn't open automatically, so I opened it manually every time, and they say that if you don't do this, mold can grow later. This function that opens slightly when it's finished is really good. :) Overall rating I used to place small items on top of the sink and use the dishwasher, but the sink got cramped and I had a hard time playing Tetris with the dishes. Now it's big and spacious, so it's great. The 12-person dishwasher was too big to be built into the sink, so I was disappointed at first. But instead, since it was installed separately from the sink, the dishwasher could be raised in height. So we installed a system rack under the dishwasher to raise the height of the dishwasher. As a result, I don't have to bend my back too much to put the dishes in, and there is storage space underneath. I really like it and have been using it well since installation. Also, Coupang provides after-sales service, so I highly recommend this product. :)
Comments (Original): 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.  마이디어 12인용 식기세척기  그동안 4인용 식기세척기를 사용하다가 너무 작고 좁아서 더 큰걸 찾고있었는데 운좋게 12인용 식기세척기를 사용됐습니다.  제조사는 중국이지만 쿠팡에서 수입하고 A/S도 쿠팡에서 진행하니 믿고 사용할 수 있을꺼같습니다.  ▶ 디자인, 크기 √ 하얀 색상과 검은색 터치패널로 깔끔하고 이쁩니다. √ 크기는 가로 598mm, 뒷폭 600mm, 높이 845mm로 12인용 답게 크기가 커요. 우리집 싱크대에는 매립하기엔 가로길이는 어찌 맞춘다지만 높이랑 깊이때문에 맞지않더라고요. 그래서 싱크대에 매립하진 못하고 단독으로 싱크대 수전 뒤쪽으로 설치했습니다. √ 제품과 연결되어있는 배출호스가 생각보다 짧지않아서 제품은 싱크대 뒤쪽에 있지만 싱크대 밑에있는 배관과 연결할 수 있었어요.  ▶ 내부구성 √ 내부는 3단으로 구성되어있어서 1단에는 큰 접시와 후라이팬등 큰 식기들도 충분히 들어갈 수있어요. √ 2단에는 자주 쓰이는 밥그릇, 국그릇, 접시등 중소형 식기를 올려놓을 수 있으며, 제일 상단은 수저나 칼 가위 같은거 놓을 있습니다. √ 너무 겹쳐서 세척이 잘 안되는건 아닐까 했는데 각 트레이마다 물 나오는 노즐이 있으며, 상하단으로 강하게 뿌려주기 때문에 세척력은 뛰어납니다.  ▶ 기능 √ 전면부 패널은 필요한 조작이 바로 표시되어있어서 조작하기 너무 쉬워요. √ 고온세척시 90도까지 오르니 더 세척력이 뛰어난거 같습니다. √ 상하단 버튼이 있어서 필요시 상단 또는 하단에만 식기 세척을 할수 있어요. - 이렇게 기능 버튼의 글자만으로 모든 기능을 이해완료 할 정도입니다.^^ √ 남은 시간도 표시해주니 언제 끝나는지 바로 알 수 있으며, 끝나면 전면에 있는 문이 살짝 열려요. 그래서 안에 있는 열기와 습기가 날라갑니다. 그동안 사용했던 작은 식기세척기는 자동으로 열리지않아서 매번 수동으로 열어줬는데, 이렇게 안하면 나중에는 곰팡이가 생길 수 있다고도 하네요. 끝나면 살짝 열리는 이기능 너무 좋습니다. :)  ▶ 총 평 식기세척기는 그동안 싱크대 위에 작은걸 올려 놓고 사용하다보니 싱크대도 비좁아지고, 힘들게 식기로 테트리스 해가면서 사용해왔는데요. 이젠 크고 공간도 넓어서 너무 좋습니다. 12인용 식시세척기가 너무 커서 싱크대에 매립되지않아 처음에는 아쉬웠는데요. 오히려 싱크대와 분리해서 설치하다보니 식기세척기 높이를 올릴 수 있게 되었어요. 그래서 저희는 식기세척기밑에 시스템랙을 설치하여 식기세척기 높이를 올렸어요. 그러다보니 식기들을 넣는다고 허리를 많이 구부리지않아도 되고 밑으로는 수납공간이 생겼습니다. 너무너무 마음에 들고 설치이후에 잘 사용하고있습니다. 또한 쿠팡에서 A/S까지 해주니 이제품 적극적으로 추천합니다. :)

Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Mydia 12-person dishwasher I had been using a 4-person dishwasher, but it was too small and narrow, so I was looking for a bigger one, and luckily I was able to use a 12-person dishwasher. The manufacturer is in China, but Coupang imports it and Coupang also handles after-sales service, so I think I can use it with confidence. Design, size It is neat and pretty with a white color and black touch panel. The size is 598mm in width, 600mm in back width, and 845mm in height, so it is large as expected for 12 people. Although the width is suitable for installing it in my sink, it does not fit because of the height and depth. So I couldn't install it in the sink and installed it alone behind the sink faucet. The exhaust hose connected to the product was not as short as I thought, so the product was behind the sink, but I was able to connect it to the pipe under the sink. Internal structure The interior is composed of three stages, so the first stage can easily hold large dishes such as large plates and frying pans. The second level can hold small and medium-sized dishes such as rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates, and the top level can hold spoons, knives, and scissors. I was worried that it would be difficult to wash because it overlapped too much, but each tray has a nozzle that comes out of the water, and it sprays strongly from the top to the bottom, so the washing power is excellent. The front panel of the function is very easy to operate because the necessary operations are displayed right away. It seems that the washing power is even better because it goes up to 90 degrees when washing at high temperature. There are up and down buttons, so you can wash dishes only at the top or bottom when necessary. - You can understand all the functions just by the letters on the function buttons. ^^ It also shows the remaining time, so you can tell right away when it's finished, and when it's finished, the door on the front opens slightly. So the heat and moisture inside are blown away. The small dishwasher I used didn't open automatically, so I opened it manually every time, and they say that if you don't do this, mold can grow later. This function that opens slightly when it's finished is really good. :) Overall rating I used to place small items on top of the sink and use the dishwasher, but the sink got cramped and I had a hard time playing Tetris with the dishes. Now it's big and spacious, so it's great. The 12-person dishwasher was too big to be built into the sink, so I was disappointed at first. But instead, since it was installed separately from the sink, the dishwasher could be raised in height. So we installed a system rack under the dishwasher to raise the height of the dishwasher. As a result, I don't have to bend my back too much to put the dishes in, and there is storage space underneath. I really like it and have been using it well since installation. Also, Coupang provides after-sales service, so I highly recommend this product. :)

The exhaust hose connected to the product was not as short as I thought, so the product was behind the sink, but I was able to connect it to the pipe under the sink. Internal structure The interior is composed of three stages, so the first stage can easily hold large dishes such as large plates and frying pans. The second level can hold small and medium-sized dishes such as rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates, and the top level can hold spoons, knives, and scissors. I was worried that it would be difficult to wash because it overlapped too much, but each tray has a nozzle that comes out of the water, and it sprays strongly from the top to the bottom, so the washing power is excellent. The front panel of the function is very easy to operate because the necessary operations are displayed right away. It seems that the washing power is even better because it goes up to 90 degrees when washing at high temperature. There are up and down buttons, so you can wash dishes only at the top or bottom when necessary. - You can understand all the functions just by the letters on the function buttons. ^^ It also shows the remaining time, so you can tell right away when it's finished, and when it's finished, the door on the front opens slightly. So the heat and moisture inside are blown away. The small dishwasher I used didn't open automatically, so I opened it manually every time, and they say that if you don't do this, mold can grow later. This function that opens slightly when it's finished is really good. :) Overall rating I used to place small items on top of the sink and use the dishwasher, but the sink got cramped and I had a hard time playing Tetris with the dishes. Now it's big and spacious, so it's great. The 12-person dishwasher was too big to be built into the sink, so I was disappointed at first. But instead, since it was installed separately from the sink, the dishwasher could be raised in height. So we installed a system rack under the dishwasher to raise the height of the dishwasher. As a result, I don't have to bend my back too much to put the dishes in, and there is storage space underneath. I really like it and have been using it well since installation. Also, Coupang provides after-sales service, so I highly recommend this product. :)

Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Mydia 12-person dishwasher I had been using a 4-person dishwasher, but it was too small and narrow, so I was looking for a bigger one, and luckily I was able to use a 12-person dishwasher. The manufacturer is in China, but Coupang imports it and Coupang also handles after-sales service, so I think I can use it with confidence. Design, size It is neat and pretty with a white color and black touch panel. The size is 598mm in width, 600mm in back width, and 845mm in height, so it is large as expected for 12 people. Although the width is suitable for installing it in my sink, it does not fit because of the height and depth. So I couldn't install it in the sink and installed it alone behind the sink faucet. The exhaust hose connected to the product was not as short as I thought, so the product was behind the sink, but I was able to connect it to the pipe under the sink. Internal structure The interior is composed of three stages, so the first stage can easily hold large dishes such as large plates and frying pans. The second level can hold small and medium-sized dishes such as rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates, and the top level can hold spoons, knives, and scissors. I was worried that it would be difficult to wash because it overlapped too much, but each tray has a nozzle that comes out of the water, and it sprays strongly from the top to the bottom, so the washing power is excellent. The front panel of the function is very easy to operate because the necessary operations are displayed right away. It seems that the washing power is even better because it goes up to 90 degrees when washing at high temperature. There are up and down buttons, so you can wash dishes only at the top or bottom when necessary. - You can understand all the functions just by the letters on the function buttons. ^^ It also shows the remaining time, so you can tell right away when it's finished, and when it's finished, the door on the front opens slightly. So the heat and moisture inside are blown away. The small dishwasher I used didn't open automatically, so I opened it manually every time, and they say that if you don't do this, mold can grow later. This function that opens slightly when it's finished is really good. :) Overall rating I used to place small items on top of the sink and use the dishwasher, but the sink got cramped and I had a hard time playing Tetris with the dishes. Now it's big and spacious, so it's great. The 12-person dishwasher was too big to be built into the sink, so I was disappointed at first. But instead, since it was installed separately from the sink, the dishwasher could be raised in height. So we installed a system rack under the dishwasher to raise the height of the dishwasher. As a result, I don't have to bend my back too much to put the dishes in, and there is storage space underneath. I really like it and have been using it well since installation. Also, Coupang provides after-sales service, so I highly recommend this product. :)

The exhaust hose connected to the product was not as short as I thought, so the product was behind the sink, but I was able to connect it to the pipe under the sink. Internal structure The interior is composed of three stages, so the first stage can easily hold large dishes such as large plates and frying pans. The second level can hold small and medium-sized dishes such as rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates, and the top level can hold spoons, knives, and scissors. I was worried that it would be difficult to wash because it overlapped too much, but each tray has a nozzle that comes out of the water, and it sprays strongly from the top to the bottom, so the washing power is excellent. The front panel of the function is very easy to operate because the necessary operations are displayed right away. It seems that the washing power is even better because it goes up to 90 degrees when washing at high temperature. There are up and down buttons, so you can wash dishes only at the top or bottom when necessary. - You can understand all the functions just by the letters on the function buttons. ^^ It also shows the remaining time, so you can tell right away when it's finished, and when it's finished, the door on the front opens slightly. So the heat and moisture inside are blown away. The small dishwasher I used didn't open automatically, so I opened it manually every time, and they say that if you don't do this, mold can grow later. This function that opens slightly when it's finished is really good. :) Overall rating I used to place small items on top of the sink and use the dishwasher, but the sink got cramped and I had a hard time playing Tetris with the dishes. Now it's big and spacious, so it's great. The 12-person dishwasher was too big to be built into the sink, so I was disappointed at first. But instead, since it was installed separately from the sink, the dishwasher could be raised in height. So we installed a system rack under the dishwasher to raise the height of the dishwasher. As a result, I don't have to bend my back too much to put the dishes in, and there is storage space underneath. I really like it and have been using it well since installation. Also, Coupang provides after-sales service, so I highly recommend this product. :)

Sentence (English): So the heat and moisture inside are blown away.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Mydia 12-person dishwasher I had been using a 4-person dishwasher, but it was too small and narrow, so I was looking for a bigger one, and luckily I was able to use a 12-person dishwasher. The manufacturer is in China, but Coupang imports it and Coupang also handles after-sales service, so I think I can use it with confidence. Design, size It is neat and pretty with a white color and black touch panel. The size is 598mm in width, 600mm in back width, and 845mm in height, so it is large as expected for 12 people. Although the width is suitable for installing it in my sink, it does not fit because of the height and depth. So I couldn't install it in the sink and installed it alone behind the sink faucet. The exhaust hose connected to the product was not as short as I thought, so the product was behind the sink, but I was able to connect it to the pipe under the sink. Internal structure The interior is composed of three stages, so the first stage can easily hold large dishes such as large plates and frying pans. The second level can hold small and medium-sized dishes such as rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates, and the top level can hold spoons, knives, and scissors. I was worried that it would be difficult to wash because it overlapped too much, but each tray has a nozzle that comes out of the water, and it sprays strongly from the top to the bottom, so the washing power is excellent. The front panel of the function is very easy to operate because the necessary operations are displayed right away. It seems that the washing power is even better because it goes up to 90 degrees when washing at high temperature. There are up and down buttons, so you can wash dishes only at the top or bottom when necessary. - You can understand all the functions just by the letters on the function buttons. ^^ It also shows the remaining time, so you can tell right away when it's finished, and when it's finished, the door on the front opens slightly. So the heat and moisture inside are blown away. The small dishwasher I used didn't open automatically, so I opened it manually every time, and they say that if you don't do this, mold can grow later. This function that opens slightly when it's finished is really good. :) Overall rating I used to place small items on top of the sink and use the dishwasher, but the sink got cramped and I had a hard time playing Tetris with the dishes. Now it's big and spacious, so it's great. The 12-person dishwasher was too big to be built into the sink, so I was disappointed at first. But instead, since it was installed separately from the sink, the dishwasher could be raised in height. So we installed a system rack under the dishwasher to raise the height of the dishwasher. As a result, I don't have to bend my back too much to put the dishes in, and there is storage space underneath. I really like it and have been using it well since installation. Also, Coupang provides after-sales service, so I highly recommend this product. :)

The exhaust hose connected to the product was not as short as I thought, so the product was behind the sink, but I was able to connect it to the pipe under the sink. Internal structure The interior is composed of three stages, so the first stage can easily hold large dishes such as large plates and frying pans. The second level can hold small and medium-sized dishes such as rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates, and the top level can hold spoons, knives, and scissors. I was worried that it would be difficult to wash because it overlapped too much, but each tray has a nozzle that comes out of the water, and it sprays strongly from the top to the bottom, so the washing power is excellent. The front panel of the function is very easy to operate because the necessary operations are displayed right away. It seems that the washing power is even better because it goes up to 90 degrees when washing at high temperature. There are up and down buttons, so you can wash dishes only at the top or bottom when necessary. - You can understand all the functions just by the letters on the function buttons. ^^ It also shows the remaining time, so you can tell right away when it's finished, and when it's finished, the door on the front opens slightly. So the heat and moisture inside are blown away. The small dishwasher I used didn't open automatically, so I opened it manually every time, and they say that if you don't do this, mold can grow later. This function that opens slightly when it's finished is really good. :) Overall rating I used to place small items on top of the sink and use the dishwasher, but the sink got cramped and I had a hard time playing Tetris with the dishes. Now it's big and spacious, so it's great. The 12-person dishwasher was too big to be built into the sink, so I was disappointed at first. But instead, since it was installed separately from the sink, the dishwasher could be raised in height. So we installed a system rack under the dishwasher to raise the height of the dishwasher. As a result, I don't have to bend my back too much to put the dishes in, and there is storage space underneath. I really like it and have been using it well since installation. Also, Coupang provides after-sales service, so I highly recommend this product. :)
