Sentence (English): As a result, I don't have to bend my back too much to put the dishes in, and there is storage space underneath.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Mydia 12-person dishwasher I had been using a 4-person dishwasher, but it was too small and narrow, so I was looking for a bigger one, and luckily I was able to use a 12-person dishwasher. The manufacturer is in China, but Coupang imports it and Coupang also handles after-sales service, so I think I can use it with confidence. Design, size It is neat and pretty with a white color and black touch panel. The size is 598mm in width, 600mm in back width, and 845mm in height, so it is large as expected for 12 people. Although the width is suitable for installing it in my sink, it does not fit because of the height and depth. So I couldn't install it in the sink and installed it alone behind the sink faucet. The exhaust hose connected to the product was not as short as I thought, so the product was behind the sink, but I was able to connect it to the pipe under the sink. Internal structure The interior is composed of three stages, so the first stage can easily hold large dishes such as large plates and frying pans. The second level can hold small and medium-sized dishes such as rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates, and the top level can hold spoons, knives, and scissors. I was worried that it would be difficult to wash because it overlapped too much, but each tray has a nozzle that comes out of the water, and it sprays strongly from the top to the bottom, so the washing power is excellent. The front panel of the function is very easy to operate because the necessary operations are displayed right away. It seems that the washing power is even better because it goes up to 90 degrees when washing at high temperature. There are up and down buttons, so you can wash dishes only at the top or bottom when necessary. - You can understand all the functions just by the letters on the function buttons. ^^ It also shows the remaining time, so you can tell right away when it's finished, and when it's finished, the door on the front opens slightly. So the heat and moisture inside are blown away. The small dishwasher I used didn't open automatically, so I opened it manually every time, and they say that if you don't do this, mold can grow later. This function that opens slightly when it's finished is really good. :) Overall rating I used to place small items on top of the sink and use the dishwasher, but the sink got cramped and I had a hard time playing Tetris with the dishes. Now it's big and spacious, so it's great. The 12-person dishwasher was too big to be built into the sink, so I was disappointed at first. But instead, since it was installed separately from the sink, the dishwasher could be raised in height. So we installed a system rack under the dishwasher to raise the height of the dishwasher. As a result, I don't have to bend my back too much to put the dishes in, and there is storage space underneath. I really like it and have been using it well since installation. Also, Coupang provides after-sales service, so I highly recommend this product. :)

Excellent cleaning power, large capacity, various customized courses, and remote control with the app. The Mydia dishwasher is truly a new world! First of all, the white color matches the white-toned kitchen very well! It matches so well that I thought it was perfect, and the size is just perfect! I felt so good after installing it ^0^ I only brought in one dishwasher, but my kitchen definitely felt luxurious. The capacity is for 12 people, so I can fit a lot of dishes and put everything in, but there was still space. In particular, it can accommodate frying pans, pots, etc. ^^ I thought it was possible because it is for 12 people! I put all of these in and still had room~~~~ The height of the shelf can also be adjusted, so it is really a godsend to adjust it according to the situation! The cleaning power is also very good, so I roughly wiped off the stuck-on stuff after making steamed eggs and put it in, and it was really clean. Honestly, I didn't expect this level of cleaning power, but I was really, really impressed! It was so much cleaner and shinier than washing dishes by hand, and I thought, oh, the technology is really great! The washing mode can be adjusted to suit the situation, which is also an advantage. In particular, the baby product washing course can be sterilized at high temperatures, so it was really hygienic and clean, which was even better. Since you can use the app to schedule washing or operate it, I felt like I was living in a really smart, cutting-edge era. The noise wasn't too bothersome, so it was fine even though I'm sensitive! Also, the automatic door opening function after washing is finished is really good. It evaporates moisture and dries better, so I felt like this function was essential for a dishwasher. I really like this dishwasher with its generous capacity, smart use, and sophisticated design. I'm so happy^^* Why did I only try this great thing now? I can't imagine life without a dishwasher anymore. It's so great to be able to manage dishes and utensils more cleanly and hygienically than washing dishes by hand, free from the hell of dishwashing!

Excellent cleaning power, large capacity, various customized courses, and remote control with the app. The Mydia dishwasher is truly a new world! First of all, the white color matches the white-toned kitchen very well! It matches so well that I thought it was perfect, and the size is just perfect! I felt so good after installing it ^0^ I only brought in one dishwasher, but my kitchen definitely felt luxurious. The capacity is for 12 people, so I can fit a lot of dishes and put everything in, but there was still space. In particular, it can accommodate frying pans, pots, etc. ^^ I thought it was possible because it is for 12 people! I put all of these in and still had room~~~~ The height of the shelf can also be adjusted, so it is really a godsend to adjust it according to the situation! The cleaning power is also very good, so I roughly wiped off the stuck-on stuff after making steamed eggs and put it in, and it was really clean. Honestly, I didn't expect this level of cleaning power, but I was really, really impressed! It was so much cleaner and shinier than washing dishes by hand, and I thought, oh, the technology is really great! The washing mode can be adjusted to suit the situation, which is also an advantage. In particular, the baby product washing course can be sterilized at high temperatures, so it was really hygienic and clean, which was even better. Since you can use the app to schedule washing or operate it, I felt like I was living in a really smart, cutting-edge era. The noise wasn't too bothersome, so it was fine even though I'm sensitive! Also, the automatic door opening function after washing is finished is really good. It evaporates moisture and dries better, so I felt like this function was essential for a dishwasher. I really like this dishwasher with its generous capacity, smart use, and sophisticated design. I'm so happy^^* Why did I only try this great thing now? I can't imagine life without a dishwasher anymore. It's so great to be able to manage dishes and utensils more cleanly and hygienically than washing dishes by hand, free from the hell of dishwashing!

Comments (Original): [ 짱좋아용 ] || ---------------- || 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.  이번에 쿠팡 체험단을 통해 마이디어 식기세척기 12인용 MDWEF1233G(A)-KR 모델을 사용해보게 되었어요. 평소 식기세척기 구매를 고민만 하다가 이번 기회에 직접 사용해보니 왜 진작에 들이지 않았을까 하는 후회가 들 정도로 만족도가 높았습니다.  우선 12인용이라 넉넉한 용량이 마음에 들었어요. 평소 집에서 하루 2~3끼는 꼭 챙겨 먹는 편인데, 냄비며 프라이팬까지도 여유롭게 넣을 수 있어 정말 편리했습니다. 내부 바스켓 구조도 실용적이라 접시, 컵, 젓가락 등 다양한 식기를 구분해서 깔끔하게 넣을 수 있었고요. 식기 위치만 잘 맞추면 세척력도 정말 우수했어요. 기름기 많은 프라이팬도 번쩍번쩍!  모터 소음도 생각보다 조용해서 밤에도 부담 없이 돌릴 수 있었고, 세척 모드도 다양하게 구성되어 있어 상황에 따라 선택할 수 있는 점이 좋았습니다. 특히 고온세척 기능이 있어 위생 걱정도 덜고요. 에너지 소비 효율도 괜찮은 편이라 전기세 걱정도 크게 없었어요.  디자인은 깔끔하고 모던해서 주방 어디에 둬도 잘 어울릴 듯합니다. 조작도 직관적이고 디지털 디스플레이가 있어 사용법이 어렵지 않았어요. 설치는 전문가가 와서 간단하게 진행해 주셔서 처음 사용하시는 분들도 걱정 없이 사용하실 수 있을 거예요.  총평하자면, 가격 대비 성능이 뛰어난 제품이라 적극 추천드립니다. 마이디어 식기세척기 덕분에 설거지 스트레스에서 해방되어 하루가 훨씬 여유로워졌어요. 특히 가족 구성원이 많거나 집에서 식사 자주 하시는 분들께는 꼭 추천드리고 싶어요!

At first, the Mydia brand was unfamiliar, but I found out that Media recently changed its name to Mydia. For your information, Mydia is a brand that is selected as one of the top three home appliance companies in China along with Haier and Guri Electric. I am more familiar with Media, and the reason I am familiar with it is because they are famous for handling OEM/ODM for large brands in Korea such as Samsung, ElX, KuX, CaX, and SK MaX. I found out a while ago while looking into home appliances, but there are quite a few products that are Mydia when you take them apart, such as microwaves, washing machines, refrigerators, air conditioners, and dishwashers. That's why the quality is really trustworthy. The delivery person calls me around 7 AM on the day I specified and tells me what time he will be there! We reserved space in advance, so it didn't take that long. One thing I'd like to ask is that most dishwashers distributed in Korea are 815 mm in height, but this product is 845 mm! I want you to check this part. It's for 12 people, so it's a bit big! (Size 598*600*845) When I connected the cord and turned it on, icons appeared on the display. It's big and very intuitive, so I thought that even older people would be able to use it without too much difficulty. As expected of a new product, there's a dedicated app so you can control it remotely. Of course, it washes dishes very well! Normally, you can use the standard mode (79 minutes), and when you need to wash dishes with some oil or high contamination, you can use the strong mode or high-temperature washing. Those who are raising a newborn baby may find the night mode equipped with a low-noise mode useful. However, when I tried it once, the noise was not as loud as I thought even in the standard mode. As expected, since it is the latest model, the performance is. ( ) Anyway, to summarize the conclusion - Working couples who are short on time - Housewives or parents with weak wrists - People who are lazy to wash dishes - People who do not necessarily need a large brand dishwasher. I think the Mydia dishwasher is a very good choice for those who fall into the above categories. This is because when you look at large major brands, there are issues such as the brand name + expensive celebrity advertisement model fees, etc., so the price range can be a concern, but this Mydia dishwasher supports the functions to some extent and is priced under 1 million won, so I think it is actually great in terms of cost-effectiveness. I am not really concerned about brands! It might be a really good choice for those who say that.

I am more familiar with Media, and the reason I am familiar with it is because they are famous for handling OEM/ODM for large brands in Korea such as Samsung, ElX, KuX, CaX, and SK MaX. We reserved space in advance, so it didn't take that long. One thing I'd like to ask is that most dishwashers distributed in Korea are 815 mm in height, but this product is 845 mm! I want you to check this part. It's for 12 people, so it's a bit big! (Size 598*600*845) When I connected the cord and turned it on, icons appeared on the display. It's big and very intuitive, so I thought that even older people would be able to use it without too much difficulty. As expected of a new product, there's a dedicated app so you can control it remotely. Of course, it washes dishes very well! Normally, you can use the standard mode (79 minutes), and when you need to wash dishes with some oil or high contamination, you can use the strong mode or high-temperature washing. Those who are raising a newborn baby may find the night mode equipped with a low-noise mode useful. However, when I tried it once, the noise was not as loud as I thought even in the standard mode. As expected, since it is the latest model, the performance is. ( ) Anyway, to summarize the conclusion - Working couples who are short on time - Housewives or parents with weak wrists - People who are lazy to wash dishes - People who do not necessarily need a large brand dishwasher. I think the Mydia dishwasher is a very good choice for those who fall into the above categories. This is because when you look at large major brands, there are issues such as the brand name + expensive celebrity advertisement model fees, etc., so the price range can be a concern, but this Mydia dishwasher supports the functions to some extent and is priced under 1 million won, so I think it is actually great in terms of cost-effectiveness. Comments (English): [ A very reasonable 12-person dishwasher in many ways! ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Since I am a family of four, after eating a meal or cooking a few side dishes, the dishes always pile up like a mountain, and especially when the family is home on the weekends, eating three meals and washing the dishes is a real job; this Mydia 12-person dishwasher has a clean design and a large capacity, so it can fit everything from large pots to frying pans, which is really great (as expected, dishwashers do not avoid the formula of a large size.) At first, the Mydia brand was unfamiliar, but I found out that Media recently changed its name to Mydia. For your information, Mydia is a brand that is selected as one of the top three home appliance companies in China along with Haier and Guri Electric. I am more familiar with Media, and the reason I am familiar with it is because they are famous for handling OEM/ODM for large brands in Korea such as Samsung, ElX, KuX, CaX, and SK MaX. I found out a while ago while looking into home appliances, but there are quite a few products that are Mydia when you take them apart, such as microwaves, washing machines, refrigerators, air conditioners, and dishwashers. That's why the quality is really trustworthy. The delivery person calls me around 7 AM on the day I specified and tells me what time he will be there! We reserved space in advance, so it didn't take that long. One thing I'd like to ask is that most dishwashers distributed in Korea are 815 mm in height, but this product is 845 mm! I want you to check this part. It's for 12 people, so it's a bit big! (Size 598*600*845) When I connected the cord and turned it on, icons appeared on the display. It's big and very intuitive, so I thought that even older people would be able to use it without too much difficulty. As expected of a new product, there's a dedicated app so you can control it remotely. Of course, it washes dishes very well! Normally, you can use the standard mode (79 minutes), and when you need to wash dishes with some oil or high contamination, you can use the strong mode or high-temperature washing. Those who are raising a newborn baby may find the night mode equipped with a low-noise mode useful. However, when I tried it once, the noise was not as loud as I thought even in the standard mode. As expected, since it is the latest model, the performance is. ( ) Anyway, to summarize the conclusion - Working couples who are short on time - Housewives or parents with weak wrists - People who are lazy to wash dishes - People who do not necessarily need a large brand dishwasher. I think the Mydia dishwasher is a very good choice for those who fall into the above categories. This is because when you look at large major brands, there are issues such as the brand name + expensive celebrity advertisement model fees, etc., so the price range can be a concern, but this Mydia dishwasher supports the functions to some extent and is priced under 1 million won, so I think it is actually great in terms of cost-effectiveness. I am not really concerned about brands! It might be a really good choice for those who say that.

Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. I recently purchased a new 12-person dishwasher and had a very satisfying experience. First of all, the installation process was simple and the technician explained it kindly, so even a first-time user could use it easily. In particular, the on-site installation service completed the installation neatly, which greatly improved the usability of the kitchen space. What surprised me the most while using it was the cleaning power and convenience. I cleaned all the dishes that had piled up after the housewarming at once, and even though the food was hard, it came out clean after sprinkling some water and turning it on. The cups, plates, and pots were all washed cleanly, and thanks to the automatic door opening function, they were completely dried, so there was no need for additional drying. I was amazed to see that even the pot that had a lot of red pepper powder on it was completely washed. Also, the internal space was spacious, so I could put dishes of various sizes at once, and thanks to the height adjustment function of the upper basket, I could put in large pots and plates without difficulty. The standard mode was sufficiently clean, but when there was a lot of food or a lot of dirt, using the powerful mode was definitely more effective. I used an all-in-one detergent, and it was easy to manage because it included a rinse. However, it was a bit noisy, so I think I should be careful when running it at night. However, this level of noise was not uncomfortable at all compared to the convenience. Above all, the dishwashing time was greatly reduced, so I felt less back pain, and I was able to spend more time with my family. Now, I am so satisfied that it is hard to imagine life without a dishwasher. I think I know why it is recommended for newlyweds!
Comments (Original): 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.  얼마 전 새로 들인 12인용 식기세척기를 사용해보고 정말 만족스러운 경험을 했어요.  먼저, 설치 과정이 간단하고 기사님이 친절하게 설명해주셔서 처음 사용하는 사람도 쉽게 다룰 수 있었답니다.  특히 방문 설치 서비스를 통해 설치가 깔끔하게 완료되어 주방 공간 활용도 훨씬 좋아졌어요.  사용하면서 가장 놀랐던 점은 세척력과 편리함이었어요.  집들이 후 쌓인 설거지거리를 한 번에 처리했는데, 음식물이 굳은 상태였음에도 물 한 번 뿌리고 돌리니 뽀득뽀득하게 나왔어요.  컵, 접시, 냄비까지 모두 깨끗하게 세척되고, 특히 자동 문 열림 기능 덕분에 건조까지 완벽히 되어 나와서 추가 건조 작업이 필요 없었어요.  고춧가루가 잔뜩 묻어 있던 냄비도 말끔히 세척된 모습을 보고 감탄했답니다.  또한, 내부 공간이 넉넉해서 다양한 크기의 식기를 한 번에 넣을 수 있었고, 상단 바구니 높이 조절 기능 덕분에 큰 냄비나 접시도 무리 없이 들어갔어요.  표준 모드로도 충분히 깨끗하게 세척되었지만, 양이 많거나 더러움이 심할 때는 강력 모드를 사용하면 확실히 더 효과적이었어요.  세제는 올인원 타입을 사용했는데, 린스까지 포함된 제품이라 관리가 간편했어요.  다만, 소음은 약간 있는 편이라 밤에 돌릴 때는 신경 써야 할 것 같아요.  하지만 이 정도 소음은 편리함과 비교하면 전혀 불편하지 않았답니다.  무엇보다 설거지 시간이 크게 줄어들면서 허리 통증도 덜 느껴지고, 가족들과 더 많은 시간을 보낼 수 있게 된 점이 가장 좋았어요.  이제는 식기세척기가 없는 생활을 상상하기 어려울 정도로 만족스럽습니다.  왜 신혼부부 가전제품 추천하는 이유를 알거 같아요!

Sentence (English): For me, who has been using a dishwasher for a long time, a dishwasher was an essential appliance.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. For me, who has been using a dishwasher for a long time, a dishwasher was an essential appliance. However, my mother, who has only washed dishes by hand her entire life, still had a hard time with her wrists because she washed dishes by hand. It has a stylish and modern style, so it goes well anywhere in the kitchen, and the size is just right, so it wasn't burdensome. I was worried that it would take up too much space if it was too big or bulky, but my mother liked it because it was clean and simple, saying, "The kitchen looks more sophisticated." The performance was also better than expected. It has strong cleaning power from top to bottom, so even greasy dishes were cleaned cleanly. In particular, it was possible to customize the washing according to the level of contamination, so I was able to shorten the dishwashing time compared to usual. Above all, it was great that it was large enough for 12 people, so I could wash all the dishes I used all day at once. My mom used to take several breaks every time she washed dishes because her wrists hurt, but now I only have to run the dishwasher once a day, so it’s much easier. Also, since it has a blower drying function and an automatic door opening function, it was cleanly dried after washing, so I didn’t have to worry about moisture. It was even more convenient because the door automatically opened after the dishwasher was finished operating, effectively removing the moisture inside, without the hassle of having to open the door. The operation method was also very easy. The front touch panel was easy to operate and intuitive, so even my mom, who is turning 60 in a day or two, could use it without difficulty. At first, she wondered, “Can I use this well?” but after using it a few times, she quickly got used to it and now she can use it by herself. Sometimes, after putting the dishes in the dishwasher and running it, I remember that I missed a dish, but since there is a function that allows you to add dishes while washing, I was able to solve this mistake without any problems. And above all, the delivery man was so kind. He didn't just install it, but he also helped me with a water purifier hose problem at my mother's house, and he explained the operating methods in detail. Lastly, he even tested the dishwasher to make sure it was working properly, and I was even more satisfied thanks to such meticulous service. When I thought about how hard my mother had been washing dishes by hand, I regretted not giving it to her sooner, but I also felt good and proud because I thought that my mother would love it, and that she would now be able to wash dishes comfortably without worrying about wrist pain.

Sentence (English): Reason for purchase: I've been married for a year now!
Comments (English): [ Smart and modern design 12-person dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Reason for purchase: I've been married for a year now! My child came right after I got married, and as my family grew, so did the dishes. On top of that, I had to invite guests often and eat with my family. I was okay with cooking, but I always had a hard time with the dishes, so I wish I had a dishwasher. Luckily, I was able to experience the 'Mydia Dishwasher 12-person Ivory' product as a Coupang Experience Group member. This product is said to be a premium dishwasher with powerful cleaning power and an efficient drying system with an automatic door opening! First of all, since it's for 12 people, I'm not afraid no matter how many guests come. I was always invited to eat and clean up, so I couldn't join in on the conversation, but I think I can join in. It also has 9 different washing courses, so I think I can wash it in a customized way each time. And it can wash more dishes with practical storage and efficient internal design, and it has two-stage upper and lower washing wings for powerful three-dimensional washing! And what I like the most is that it can be controlled by mobile! It seems like a very smart function that you can control it at any time you want from outside. Installation review: The technician contacted me on the morning of the day of installation to tell me when he would visit. He arrived at the appointed time without delay and kindly consulted and installed it! There was no mechanical failure or box explosion, and since my house is not my own, I had to use a stand instead of a built-in one, but the dishwasher was bigger than I thought (60x60x85. Please note!). I was really stressed out about where to put it, but he kindly gave me recommendations, installed it well, and explained how to use the machine and tips at the end~ User review: First of all, the design is very simple and good! And the washing courses are automatic, standard, strong, rinse and dry, high temperature washing, night, and separate washing of the upper and lower parts, so it is very convenient! When there are no guests in my house, I thought that a 12-person dishwasher would be too big for a 3-person household. Fortunately, it can be washed separately, so I think it will be used very efficiently. Also, it has different settings for the level of contamination! It seems very convenient. And it has a ventilation drying and automatic door opening function, so it dries quickly and powerfully! You don't have to worry about mold either. Raising children is hard, but if you also have a hard time with housework, you get so tired. Thanks to this, I think I will have free time, so I am looking forward to it. Overall review: A smart and modern 12-person dishwasher

Comments (English): [ Smart and modern design 12-person dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. This product is said to be a premium dishwasher with powerful cleaning power and an efficient drying system with an automatic door opening! First of all, since it's for 12 people, I'm not afraid no matter how many guests come. I was always invited to eat and clean up, so I couldn't join in on the conversation, but I think I can join in. It also has 9 different washing courses, so I think I can wash it in a customized way each time. And it can wash more dishes with practical storage and efficient internal design, and it has two-stage upper and lower washing wings for powerful three-dimensional washing! And what I like the most is that it can be controlled by mobile! It seems like a very smart function that you can control it at any time you want from outside. Installation review: The technician contacted me on the morning of the day of installation to tell me when he would visit. He arrived at the appointed time without delay and kindly consulted and installed it! There was no mechanical failure or box explosion, and since my house is not my own, I had to use a stand instead of a built-in one, but the dishwasher was bigger than I thought (60x60x85. Please note!). I was really stressed out about where to put it, but he kindly gave me recommendations, installed it well, and explained how to use the machine and tips at the end~ User review: First of all, the design is very simple and good! And the washing courses are automatic, standard, strong, rinse and dry, high temperature washing, night, and separate washing of the upper and lower parts, so it is very convenient! Raising children is hard, but if you also have a hard time with housework, you get so tired. Thanks to this, I think I will have free time, so I am looking forward to it. Overall review: A smart and modern 12-person dishwasher

The dishes are really shiny and shiny~ and the cutlery set~ and cutting board are washed warmly, so it seems really clean and hygienic. It is also quiet. It's a must-have item. Hello. I'm a mother of a family of four raising a son and a daughter. Usability and advantages The control panel has various functions. The automatic mode automatically detects and washes dirty dishes, and the standard mode is just light and standard for washing ordinary laundry. The standard mode is really effective for a small amount of time, so I'd like to say that the drying function is a little weak. Powerful mode can be used to wash very dirty dishes and food stuck to them. Rinse and dry can be used to rinse and dry dishes that have been stored for a long time. High-temperature washing: Up to 75 degrees Celsius, it can sterilize glass and dishes at high temperatures. Night mode: It is good to use in the evening because it is quiet. I would like to say that it is a mode optimized for energy saving. It washes large-capacity dishes cleanly. Even a large pot can be washed cleanly, and large, medium, and small plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and various cooking utensils, coffee cups, glassware, and plastic dishes were washed cleanly without melting. You can download the smart home app and control it remotely. There is a glass care, full-cleaning mode, and soaking mode, so you can wash it according to your needs. The soaking mode was especially useful when collecting and washing as a spare. The Wi-Fi function is connected to the product, so it is easy to connect wirelessly and disconnect the app. The composition of the upper tray, lower tray, multipurpose shelf, and cutlery basket allows you to arrange and wash them by size and function. If there are utensils on the upper side, press the upper side, and if there are utensils on the lower side, you can separate and wash them by dividing them into the lower side! It seems really practical. The clean design and luxurious color give the kitchen interior an interior effect. The product I chose is a soft yet warm ivory color, and I tried it as a built-in, and it is luxurious and harmonizes with other colors without any sense of dissonance. It is really, really pretty. My kitchen has really brightened up. It is hygienic and convenient to dry because it has an automatic door opening function after washing. It is a KC certified product, so it is reliable and can be used with confidence. They say that A/S is also guaranteed for 2 years free of charge. The price is reasonable for the quality. It has many functions, and as you can see even in the standard mode, the dual cleaning nozzle washes away all the stains and foreign substances. You can put in utensils that were not in the middle, and you can also add a rinse function and change the course during washing. The dishes are really shiny and shiny~ and the cutlery set~ and cutting board are washed warmly, so it seems really clean and hygienic. It is also quiet. In my opinion, it seems to be quieter than the sound of a dryer. Although my opinion is subjective, please use it as a reference. Things to note Be sure to wash with a dishwasher-specific detergent. Otherwise, the foam will leak out, so please be careful. You should open the door occasionally to completely dry it to reduce the growth of bacteria, and cleaning the filter and washing wings after use can also improve the cleaning performance, so you should manage it periodically to prevent clogging of the filter and wing spray holes. Overall review I am someone who did not know that a dishwasher was this convenient~~~^^ Having one of these at home makes my body and mind comfortable. Cooking is busy and so hard, but it is also so hard to cook, eat, and clean up~ It is also so hard and tiring to clean up! Now, put your cutlery in the dishwasher and rest easy. I highly recommend it to dads and moms who are raising children. It washes well, has many automatic functions, and is of high quality. It's a must-have item. Hello. I'm a mother of a family of four raising a son and a daughter. Usability and advantages The control panel has various functions. The automatic mode automatically detects and washes dirty dishes, and the standard mode is just light and standard for washing ordinary laundry. The standard mode is really effective for a small amount of time, so I'd like to say that the drying function is a little weak. Powerful mode can be used to wash very dirty dishes and food stuck to them. Rinse and dry can be used to rinse and dry dishes that have been stored for a long time. High-temperature washing: Up to 75 degrees Celsius, it can sterilize glass and dishes at high temperatures. Night mode: It is good to use in the evening because it is quiet. I would like to say that it is a mode optimized for energy saving. It washes large-capacity dishes cleanly. Even a large pot can be washed cleanly, and large, medium, and small plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and various cooking utensils, coffee cups, glassware, and plastic dishes were washed cleanly without melting. You can download the smart home app and control it remotely. There is a glass care, full-cleaning mode, and soaking mode, so you can wash it according to your needs. The soaking mode was especially useful when collecting and washing as a spare. The Wi-Fi function is connected to the product, so it is easy to connect wirelessly and disconnect the app. The composition of the upper tray, lower tray, multipurpose shelf, and cutlery basket allows you to arrange and wash them by size and function. If there are utensils on the upper side, press the upper side, and if there are utensils on the lower side, you can separate and wash them by dividing them into the lower side! It seems really practical. The clean design and luxurious color give the kitchen interior an interior effect. The product I chose is a soft yet warm ivory color, and I tried it as a built-in, and it is luxurious and harmonizes with other colors without any sense of dissonance. It is really, really pretty. My kitchen has really brightened up. It is hygienic and convenient to dry because it has an automatic door opening function after washing. It is a KC certified product, so it is reliable and can be used with confidence. They say that A/S is also guaranteed for 2 years free of charge. The price is reasonable for the quality. It has many functions, and as you can see even in the standard mode, the dual cleaning nozzle washes away all the stains and foreign substances. You can put in utensils that were not in the middle, and you can also add a rinse function and change the course during washing. The dishes are really shiny and shiny~ and the cutlery set~ and cutting board are washed warmly, so it seems really clean and hygienic. It is also quiet. In my opinion, it seems to be quieter than the sound of a dryer. Although my opinion is subjective, please use it as a reference. Things to note Be sure to wash with a dishwasher-specific detergent. Otherwise, the foam will leak out, so please be careful. You should open the door occasionally to completely dry it to reduce the growth of bacteria, and cleaning the filter and washing wings after use can also improve the cleaning performance, so you should manage it periodically to prevent clogging of the filter and wing spray holes. Overall review I am someone who did not know that a dishwasher was this convenient~~~^^ Having one of these at home makes my body and mind comfortable. Cooking is busy and so hard, but it is also so hard to cook, eat, and clean up~ It is also so hard and tiring to clean up! Now, put your cutlery in the dishwasher and rest easy. I highly recommend it to dads and moms who are raising children. It washes well, has many automatic functions, and is of high quality. The dishes are really shiny and shiny~ and the cutlery set~ and cutting board are washed warmly, so it seems really clean and hygienic. It is also quiet. Just put in the dishes and you're done! It's really a new era. I want to give it to my parents-in-law with its sophisticated and clean design. Moms & dads & those who are tired of housework! It's a must-have item. Hello. I'm a mother of a family of four raising a son and a daughter. Since we're a family of four, we cook a lot of food, and as a result, all kinds of cooking utensils and dishes pile up. I had a great opportunity to choose a Mydia dishwasher, and our new era aunt! I've started using the Mydia dishwasher. As a mother and a daughter of a family, I'll write an honest and honest review to help you as much as possible. Usability and advantages The control panel has various functions. The automatic mode automatically detects and washes dirty dishes, and the standard mode is just light and standard for washing ordinary laundry. The standard mode is really effective for a small amount of time, so I'd like to say that the drying function is a little weak. Powerful mode can be used to wash very dirty dishes and food stuck to them. Rinse and dry can be used to rinse and dry dishes that have been stored for a long time. High-temperature washing: Up to 75 degrees Celsius, it can sterilize glass and dishes at high temperatures. Night mode: It is good to use in the evening because it is quiet. I would like to say that it is a mode optimized for energy saving. It washes large-capacity dishes cleanly. Even a large pot can be washed cleanly, and large, medium, and small plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and various cooking utensils, coffee cups, glassware, and plastic dishes were washed cleanly without melting. You can download the smart home app and control it remotely. There is a glass care, full-cleaning mode, and soaking mode, so you can wash it according to your needs. The soaking mode was especially useful when collecting and washing as a spare. The Wi-Fi function is connected to the product, so it is easy to connect wirelessly and disconnect the app. The composition of the upper tray, lower tray, multipurpose shelf, and cutlery basket allows you to arrange and wash them by size and function. If there are utensils on the upper side, press the upper side, and if there are utensils on the lower side, you can separate and wash them by dividing them into the lower side! It seems really practical. The clean design and luxurious color give the kitchen interior an interior effect. The product I chose is a soft yet warm ivory color, and I tried it as a built-in, and it is luxurious and harmonizes with other colors without any sense of dissonance. It is really, really pretty. My kitchen has really brightened up. It is hygienic and convenient to dry because it has an automatic door opening function after washing. It is a KC certified product, so it is reliable and can be used with confidence. They say that A/S is also guaranteed for 2 years free of charge. The price is reasonable for the quality. It has many functions, and as you can see even in the standard mode, the dual cleaning nozzle washes away all the stains and foreign substances. You can put in utensils that were not in the middle, and you can also add a rinse function and change the course during washing. The dishes are really shiny and shiny~ and the cutlery set~ and cutting board are washed warmly, so it seems really clean and hygienic. It is also quiet. In my opinion, it seems to be quieter than the sound of a dryer. Although my opinion is subjective, please use it as a reference. Things to note Be sure to wash with a dishwasher-specific detergent. Otherwise, the foam will leak out, so please be careful. You should open the door occasionally to completely dry it to reduce the growth of bacteria, and cleaning the filter and washing wings after use can also improve the cleaning performance, so you should manage it periodically to prevent clogging of the filter and wing spray holes. Overall review I am someone who did not know that a dishwasher was this convenient~~~^^ Having one of these at home makes my body and mind comfortable. Cooking is busy and so hard, but it is also so hard to cook, eat, and clean up~ It is also so hard and tiring to clean up! Now, put your cutlery in the dishwasher and rest easy. I highly recommend it to dads and moms who are raising children. It washes well, has many automatic functions, and is of high quality. Based on my experience using it, I want to tell you that regardless of the brand, a high-quality, mid-priced MyDiar product is sufficient. ------------------------------------------- I wrote this with sincerity in the hopes that it would be helpful to those who are considering purchasing. It's a must-have item. Hello. I'm a mother of a family of four raising a son and a daughter. Since we're a family of four, we cook a lot of food, and as a result, all kinds of cooking utensils and dishes pile up. I had a great opportunity to choose a Mydia dishwasher, and our new era aunt! I've started using the Mydia dishwasher. As a mother and a daughter of a family, I'll write an honest and honest review to help you as much as possible. Usability and advantages The control panel has various functions. The automatic mode automatically detects and washes dirty dishes, and the standard mode is just light and standard for washing ordinary laundry. The standard mode is really effective for a small amount of time, so I'd like to say that the drying function is a little weak. Powerful mode can be used to wash very dirty dishes and food stuck to them. Rinse and dry can be used to rinse and dry dishes that have been stored for a long time. High-temperature washing: Up to 75 degrees Celsius, it can sterilize glass and dishes at high temperatures. Night mode: It is good to use in the evening because it is quiet. I would like to say that it is a mode optimized for energy saving. It washes large-capacity dishes cleanly. Even a large pot can be washed cleanly, and large, medium, and small plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and various cooking utensils, coffee cups, glassware, and plastic dishes were washed cleanly without melting. You can download the smart home app and control it remotely. There is a glass care, full-cleaning mode, and soaking mode, so you can wash it according to your needs. The soaking mode was especially useful when collecting and washing as a spare. The Wi-Fi function is connected to the product, so it is easy to connect wirelessly and disconnect the app. The composition of the upper tray, lower tray, multipurpose shelf, and cutlery basket allows you to arrange and wash them by size and function. If there are utensils on the upper side, press the upper side, and if there are utensils on the lower side, you can separate and wash them by dividing them into the lower side! It seems really practical. The clean design and luxurious color give the kitchen interior an interior effect. The product I chose is a soft yet warm ivory color, and I tried it as a built-in, and it is luxurious and harmonizes with other colors without any sense of dissonance. It is really, really pretty. My kitchen has really brightened up. It is hygienic and convenient to dry because it has an automatic door opening function after washing. It is a KC certified product, so it is reliable and can be used with confidence. They say that A/S is also guaranteed for 2 years free of charge. The price is reasonable for the quality. It has many functions, and as you can see even in the standard mode, the dual cleaning nozzle washes away all the stains and foreign substances. You can put in utensils that were not in the middle, and you can also add a rinse function and change the course during washing. The dishes are really shiny and shiny~ and the cutlery set~ and cutting board are washed warmly, so it seems really clean and hygienic. It is also quiet. In my opinion, it seems to be quieter than the sound of a dryer. Although my opinion is subjective, please use it as a reference. Things to note Be sure to wash with a dishwasher-specific detergent. Otherwise, the foam will leak out, so please be careful. You should open the door occasionally to completely dry it to reduce the growth of bacteria, and cleaning the filter and washing wings after use can also improve the cleaning performance, so you should manage it periodically to prevent clogging of the filter and wing spray holes. Overall review I am someone who did not know that a dishwasher was this convenient~~~^^ Having one of these at home makes my body and mind comfortable. Cooking is busy and so hard, but it is also so hard to cook, eat, and clean up~ It is also so hard and tiring to clean up! Now, put your cutlery in the dishwasher and rest easy. I highly recommend it to dads and moms who are raising children. It washes well, has many automatic functions, and is of high quality. Based on my experience using it, I want to tell you that regardless of the brand, a high-quality, mid-priced MyDiar product is sufficient. ------------------------------------------- I wrote this with sincerity in the hopes that it would be helpful to those who are considering purchasing. The soaking mode was especially useful when collecting and washing as a spare. The Wi-Fi function is connected to the product, so it is easy to connect wirelessly and disconnect the app. The composition of the upper tray, lower tray, multipurpose shelf, and cutlery basket allows you to arrange and wash them by size and function. If there are utensils on the upper side, press the upper side, and if there are utensils on the lower side, you can separate and wash them by dividing them into the lower side! It seems really practical. The clean design and luxurious color give the kitchen interior an interior effect. My kitchen has really brightened up. It is hygienic and convenient to dry because it has an automatic door opening function after washing. It is a KC certified product, so it is reliable and can be used with confidence. They say that A/S is also guaranteed for 2 years free of charge. The price is reasonable for the quality. It has many functions, and as you can see even in the standard mode, the dual cleaning nozzle washes away all the stains and foreign substances. You can put in utensils that were not in the middle, and you can also add a rinse function and change the course during washing. The dishes are really shiny and shiny~ and the cutlery set~ and cutting board are washed warmly, so it seems really clean and hygienic. It is also quiet. In my opinion, it seems to be quieter than the sound of a dryer. Although my opinion is subjective, please use it as a reference. Things to note Be sure to wash with a dishwasher-specific detergent. Otherwise, the foam will leak out, so please be careful. You should open the door occasionally to completely dry it to reduce the growth of bacteria, and cleaning the filter and washing wings after use can also improve the cleaning performance, so you should manage it periodically to prevent clogging of the filter and wing spray holes. Overall review I am someone who did not know that a dishwasher was this convenient~~~^^ Having one of these at home makes my body and mind comfortable. The soaking mode was especially useful when collecting and washing as a spare. If there are utensils on the upper side, press the upper side, and if there are utensils on the lower side, you can separate and wash them by dividing them into the lower side! It has many functions, and as you can see even in the standard mode, the dual cleaning nozzle washes away all the stains and foreign substances. You can put in utensils that were not in the middle, and you can also add a rinse function and change the course during washing. The dishes are really shiny and shiny~ and the cutlery set~ and cutting board are washed warmly, so it seems really clean and hygienic. It is also quiet. In my opinion, it seems to be quieter than the sound of a dryer. Although my opinion is subjective, please use it as a reference. Things to note Be sure to wash with a dishwasher-specific detergent. Otherwise, the foam will leak out, so please be careful. You should open the door occasionally to completely dry it to reduce the growth of bacteria, and cleaning the filter and washing wings after use can also improve the cleaning performance, so you should manage it periodically to prevent clogging of the filter and wing spray holes. The soaking mode was especially useful when collecting and washing as a spare. If there are utensils on the upper side, press the upper side, and if there are utensils on the lower side, you can separate and wash them by dividing them into the lower side! It seems really practical. The clean design and luxurious color give the kitchen interior an interior effect. It is a KC certified product, so it is reliable and can be used with confidence. They say that A/S is also guaranteed for 2 years free of charge. The price is reasonable for the quality. It has many functions, and as you can see even in the standard mode, the dual cleaning nozzle washes away all the stains and foreign substances. You can put in utensils that were not in the middle, and you can also add a rinse function and change the course during washing. The dishes are really shiny and shiny~ and the cutlery set~ and cutting board are washed warmly, so it seems really clean and hygienic. It is also quiet. In my opinion, it seems to be quieter than the sound of a dryer. Although my opinion is subjective, please use it as a reference. Things to note Be sure to wash with a dishwasher-specific detergent. Otherwise, the foam will leak out, so please be careful. You should open the door occasionally to completely dry it to reduce the growth of bacteria, and cleaning the filter and washing wings after use can also improve the cleaning performance, so you should manage it periodically to prevent clogging of the filter and wing spray holes. Overall review I am someone who did not know that a dishwasher was this convenient~~~^^ Having one of these at home makes my body and mind comfortable. Sentence (English): This time, I moved and brought a dishwasher with me :).
Comments (English): [ Made with my own money ] || ---------------- || This time, I moved and brought a dishwasher with me :). My previous house was too small and cramped, so I was disappointed. This was the number one appliance I wanted to buy. First of all, the advantages are: *** The size for 14 people is the same, but the shelves inside are a bit different, so more dishes can fit. The price difference between a 12-person and a 14-person dishwasher can be as much as 30, so you can keep this in mind when purchasing :). *** It can be adjusted up and down. There's a handle that you can press with both hands to move it up and down. It can be adjusted so that even large plates can be easily placed in the dishwasher. ***. The most important thing is the cleaning power! Even if you put in a dishwasher full of grease, it will come out clean. It cleans well even if you stack the dishes, but I'm still a dishwasher novice, so I don't stack them often. *** Grade 1! Actually, I found out after purchasing it, but grade 1 appliances are really good, right? Products that aren't grade 1 actually cost more in electricity than you think. If I had to pick a con, it's that it doesn't dry completely, which is a bit inconvenient for me. I wish it came out completely dry, but I looked it up and found that the automatic door opens and the remaining water in the dishes is automatically dried. Not all dishes are wet, but the rice bowls that I turned over are still quite wet, so I can't put them in the sink right after using the dishwasher :(. Other than this con, I'm using the dishwasher well. If you found my review helpful, please click the recommend button :)

Sentence (English): Install was easy as it's a standard size.
Comments (English): [ cleans well and super quiet. No idea why it has wifi. ] || ---------------- || Install was easy as it's a standard size. It came with everything needed: discharge hose, connection hose, screws. Once we started a cycle we noticed how quiet it is vs our previous dishwasher. I recorded about 10 minutes of the dishwasher running and the decibel meter was around 40-70 decibels. With an average around 40 decibels. It's easy to let it run and not really know it's going. The racks handle most of our dishes, with the exception of really tall plates - like a serving platter. The top rack can be adjusted to go higher or lower, so that allows for taller things at the bottom. However, it is at the expense of the upper rack. The 3rd rack at the top is great for silverware. Much easier to empty than the basket. But, it does also comes with a basket. At first I was concerned that the handle sticking out would be problematic, but it doesn't stick out very far with our 26" deep counter. Our dishes come out clean and mostly dry. The dishwasher itself however does seem to stay damp after it has been run. So far this has not been a problem. But, if you were to run, empty and leave for a while, I could see it getting moldy. We did hook to wifi and hook to the LG app on our phone, it was fun to play with, but honestly not useful at all. I would way rather have a tall tub and forgo the wifi. Seems like it's technology just for technology sake. We did run the dishwasher without it connected to wifi and it seems fine without. The front stainless does not seem to pickup fingerprints and after 2 months it still looks clean. The readout on the top of the door is my only complaint. We have to bend down and peer through the "crack" to see how much time is left on a cycle. Seems like it would have been better to put the timer on a led in the front of the dishwasher.

Much easier to empty than the basket. But, it does also comes with a basket. At first I was concerned that the handle sticking out would be problematic, but it doesn't stick out very far with our 26' deep counter. Our dishes come out clean and mostly dry. The dishwasher itself however does seem to stay damp after it has been run. So far this has not been a problem. But, if you were to run, empty and leave for a while, I could see it getting moldy. We did hook to wifi and hook to the LG app on our phone, it was fun to play with, but honestly not useful at all. I would way rather have a tall tub and forgo the wifi. Seems like it's technology just for technology sake. We did run the dishwasher without it connected to wifi and it seems fine without.The front stainless does not seem to pickup fingerprints and after 2 months it still looks clean.The readout on the top of the door is my only complaint. We have to bend down and peer through the 'crack' to see how much time is left on a cycle. Seems like it would have been better to put the timer on a led in the front of the dishwasher.

Since there were a lot of events when the Naver Store app was created, I bought it. The color of the lower cabinet is dark, so I was worried because I couldn't choose the color, but it strangely matches well with the color of the upper cabinet, so I'm satisfied every time I install it. It was a non-standard cabinet, so I had to pay extra. The lower cabinet remodeling technician came around 1 PM, cut it, and made the storage neat. (He had the sense to put non-woven fabric on the dishwasher. Samsung's official partner is different.) The installation technician came at 4 PM and completed the installation. He kindly explained the usage and detergent and rinse, etc. Later, I bought detergent and tested it right away, and the water cup was really washed transparently (I wondered if the dishes I had washed by hand were actually dirty.). I bought it in a hurry, so I didn't know that it didn't have a hot air drying function. Instead, it has a strong drying function. At first, when I turned it on in standard mode (no drying), there was still moisture, but when I left it overnight with the door slightly open, there was no smell and it dried naturally well. When I added the optional strong drying, except for cups and large pots, the plates were dried cleanly and ready to use. If you have a house with a lot of dishwashing, I recommend a dishwasher with a hot air dryer. If you are a house that only uses it once a day like mine, I recommend this product for its cost-effectiveness. The noise is less annoying than I thought, and the night mode is even quieter. The video is the sound in standard mode. Since I don't have to do the dishes, I can talk to my family and do other things more leisurely, which is nice! I am 1000% satisfied with my purchase!

Sentence (English): We finally had to replace our worn out dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ I love my new dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || We finally had to replace our worn out dishwasher. Since we are limited with space, we needed an ADA compliant dishwasher. I was resigned to the fact that our choices would be limited as well. When we settled on a Bosch, I was hopeful that it would at least be a quality appliance but WOW, I never expected it to be as wonderful as it is! My dishes have never been so clean, I no longer have to rinse them prior to loading and it ever lets me know when it's finished through the Bosch app - which is something else I love! It fits much more than I thought it would and the flex racks are perfect. All that and it is whisper quiet. I never thought dishwashing could be so enjoyable. I highly recommend this Bosch dishwasher to anyone looking for an ADA appliance.

Sentence (English): After the old Bosch dishwasher served us faithfully and tirelessly for more than 20 years, we again settled on the well-known quality.
Comments (English): [ 20 years is enough :) ] || ---------------- || After the old Bosch dishwasher served us faithfully and tirelessly for more than 20 years, we again settled on the well-known quality. We put the new Bosch in place of the old one, we noticed the larger internal volume; the on/off button has taken on the appearance of a black screen with a row of programs; the dishes are crystal clear, the noise is lower. Our large juicer is also (Like a) Bosch, the parts themselves are dark blue/gray and do not absorb the colors of carrots, beets, parsley. The inner basket is gray, we now know why. The water and electricity consumption is optimal. Black and white are also intertwined in our kitchen, so the new dishwasher is not only functional, it sets an eloquent accent in the furnishings.
Comments (Original): [ 20 години стигат :) ] || ---------------- || След като старата миялна Bosch ни служи вярно и неуморно повече от 20 години, отново се спряхме на добре познатото качество. Новата Bosch поставихме на мястото на старата, забелязахме по-големия вътрешен обем; копчето за включване/изключване е придобило вид на черен екран с ред програми; съдовете са кристално чисти, шумът - по-нисък. Голямата ни сокоизтисквачка също е (Like a) Bosch, самите части са тъмно-сини/сиви и не поемат цветовете на моркова, цвеклото, магданоза. Вътрешната кошница е сива, вече знаем защо. Разходът на вода и ток е оптимален. Черно и бяло се преплитат и в нашата кухня, така че новата миялна машина е не само функционална, тя обособява красноречив акцент в обзавеждането.

Sentence (English): We've always used Bosch at home, ever since my parents bought it, and the truth is, it's never let us down.
Comments (English): [ Bosch Series 4 Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We've always used Bosch at home, ever since my parents bought it, and the truth is, it's never let us down. That's why, when we changed our dishwasher, we trusted the brand again, and so far we're very happy with our choice. Installation was very easy; we had it up and running in no time. It's very intuitive to use, with clear and accessible programs, even setting the hardness and rinse aid amount. The automatic door-opening function at the end of the wash has been a real success: it helps the dishes dry completely without you having to open it or wait for it to finish. The results are very good; everything comes out clean and dry, even when there's more stubborn residue. In that sense, I have no complaints. I did want to comment on something that worries me a bit, and that's the plastic where the menu is located, the part with the awning, which is a pearly-painted plastic. In our previous Bosch, that part became very dirty over time, and there was no way to make it look like new again, especially since you often use the dishwasher with somewhat dirty hands when loading dishes. I hope this model addresses this issue better. Otherwise, it's a very good purchase. It works well, is easy to use, and maintains the level of quality I've always associated with Bosch.
Comments (Original): [ Lavavajillas Bosch Serie 4 ] || ---------------- || Siempre hemos usado Bosch en casa, desde mis padres, y la verdad es que nunca nos ha fallado. Por eso, al cambiar el lavavajillas, volvimos a confiar en la marca, y de momento estamos muy contentos con la elección. La instalación fue muy fácil, en poco tiempo lo teníamos funcionando. Es muy intuitivo de usar, con los programas claros y accesibles, incluso la programación de dureza, cantidad de abrillantador. La función de apertura automática de la puerta al final del lavado ha sido todo un acierto: ayuda bastante a que la vajilla se seque del todo sin tener que abrirlo tú o estar esperando a que acabe.Los resultados son muy buenos, todo sale limpio y seco, incluso cuando hay restos más pegados. En ese sentido, no hay quejas.Sí quería comentar algo que me preocupa un poco, y es el tema del plástico donde está el menú, la parte de la marquesina, que es un plastico pintado como perlado. En nuestro anterior Bosch esa parte acabó muy manchada con el tiempo, y no hubo forma de dejarla como nueva, sobre todo porque muchas veces usas el lavavajillas con las manos algo sucias al meter los platos. Espero que en este modelo eso esté mejor resuelto.Por lo demás, muy buena compra. Funciona bien, es cómodo de usar y mantiene el nivel de calidad que siempre he asociado a Bosch.

Comments (English): [ Great but not perfect ] || ---------------- || I have had Bosch dishwashers for the best part of 30 years. Of course, the appliance store told me that this model was the same as the one with the third rack, but we know that's not true It does a beautiful job of heating the water and cleaning the dishes Since I have a tankless water system, I could never rely on hot water and had to practically wash the dishes - still like this one too.

Sentence (English): We purchased this dishwasher a few weeks ago.
Comments (English): [ Bosch Dishwasher 300 Series ] || ---------------- || We purchased this dishwasher a few weeks ago. First thing I noted was that the "smart" feature did not work because the dishwasher could not connect itself to wi-fi. After using it for a month now, I have to say it's just "ok". Instead of straightforward buttons to push to chose the wash/dry cycle, you have to "hold" down the on/off button to toggle between the wash, then do the same with the other features. I've read the instructions front to back and still cannot figure out how to set it to my desired selections and have it operate that way each time. It takes time to have to adjust it every time I want to run it. I have a computer background and consider myself above average computer literate. I am disappointed because it's just not as saavy as I would've expected from a Bosch product.

Sentence (English): I didn't realize that my old dishwasher was so bad until I bought the Bosch.
Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher but things they could improve ] || ---------------- || I didn't realize that my old dishwasher was so bad until I bought the Bosch. You do not have to rinse off ANYTHING. It will get it clean. It is VERY quiet and I love the upper 3rd silverware rack. There are a few items that Bosch could improve. 1) The white light that comes on when it is operating needs to change to green when done and stay green until someone opens it so you are reminded that it needs to be unload. 2) I use lots of bowls and they do not all fit where Bosch has the tines. I need to be able to put them on the right side (where the utensile caddy I took out was as I do not need it). But the bowls will not keep upright as nothing is there to hold them that way. There needs to be a movable tine that you can raise up to keep bowls (or anything else) upright. If you have a large item, then you can lower it.

Sentence (English): Our old dishwasher broke and we decided on the Bosch 800 series for several reasons, mainly their reputation for a quality product.
Comments (English): [ Very quiet with lots of customization options ] || ---------------- || Our old dishwasher broke and we decided on the Bosch 800 series for several reasons, mainly their reputation for a quality product. So far, we are pleased with the decision. I read so many reviews before deciding, so I am hopeful this will help others. I am very impressed with how quiet the cleaning cycle is; I can barely hear it and rely on the indicator light to tell if I started it correctly. It gets dishes very clean with minimal rinsing or pre-cleaning. The middle rack is movable to accommodate various dish heights on either rack. I love that it is a sliding method and not just to height options like other brands. You can even make the rack lopsided if you have a variety of odd shapes for a particular load. The 3rd rack has a drop down options, expanding the available height of the 3rd rack as well. I'm not a big fan of the silverware in the 3rd rack, mostly bc it is time consuming to place everything orderly. I'd prefer to toss it in a silverware basket and be done with it. There is an add on option to purchase an extra silverware basket if you share my sentiment. I do like that the 3rd rack is removable. If you do use it for silverware, that makes it easy to carry to a silverware drawer. This was not a common feature for the 3rd rack in other brands. The smart device app provides additional features you can't access from the dishwasher itself. It is easy to link and navigate the app. You *could* get by without the app if you preferred, but you can't use features like delayed start or adjust the amount of rinse aid used per cycle without the app. The feature I was most excited about was the crystal dry. It claims to leave everything, even plastics, absolutely dry after the cycle is complete. While plastics were dryer than our previous dishwasher, they definitely aren't completely dry. I tried using a rinse aid (which we previously never did) with little impact. I attempted to delay the wash cycle so it ended right before we planned to empty it, that didn't make a difference either. The directions say to load everything so that there are no areas where water could collect. This seems obvious and easy, but most things like water bottles and plastic containers are bound to have some small areas where water collects. These products, in addition to items on the 3rd rack, tend to require additional drying when we unload the dishwasher. After my initial disappointment, I did some internet searches and found the crystal dry needs time to become effective and we should notice an improvement in a month or so. I will say, it does seem to have improved, but every load several items still require towel drying. Frustrating for sure, especially if you are like me and this was your primary reason for choosing this dishwasher. However, overall, I am still pleased with the purchase. I would caution others to temper your expectations around miraculously dry dishes, especially plasticware.

Sentence (English): This Bosch dishwasher is quiet, and cleans dishes - mostly.
Comments (English): [ Not everything I would like it to be.  ] || ---------------- || This Bosch dishwasher is quiet, and cleans dishes - mostly. I'm still getting used to it, so time will tell. A few things have already jumped out at me. I am disappointed in the feel of the door. it feels flimsy in comparison to my other dishwasher, and I worry that over time it may not hold up to any rough use. The latch seems "plasticy" - it makes a loud pop when it clicks, but it seems like it could break easily. The touch controls are a little tricky - but I haven't had any problems using them, yet. I cleaned dishes this weekend, including a couple plates with egg on them - the egg did not come off. I think my biggest complaint is that the tines in this dishwasher are not flexible. I don't understand why Bosch doesn't make more tines that fold down - the design works well if you use a lot of plates, but bowls are a problem, and I use a lot of bowls. the top rack for silverware is nice, but who spends the time laying out each piece of silverware in the little holders? So. Bosch has a great reputation, and I'm hoping this machine lives up to the reputation over time, but I'm not overly impressed thus far.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher has just been a huge disappointment, and we are absolutely going to be returning to Costco before the 90 days are up.
Comments (English): [ Small, strange rack design, not quiet enough. ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher has just been a huge disappointment, and we are absolutely going to be returning to Costco before the 90 days are up. For the premium price, and brand name, I was expecting a premium product. Unfortunately, this dishwasher just leaves the impression of a mediocre product that is trying to rely on the brand name for sales.The biggest gripe we have is the internal size and upper rack design. Somehow, we are able to fit far fewer dishes in this thing than before. The top rack, literally none of our dishes fit in there, and the layout of the rack makes no sense. I have no idea what sort of dishes Bosch thinks people are putting in here, but it is not standard size glasses and bowls, that is for sure.The overall size is also just small - it seems to take up the same amount of external space as our last dishwasher, however it is definitely smaller on the inside, so less space for things.It doesn't dry the dishes well either no matter what setting is used, which is unfortunate. Lastly it is just not very quiet. My 12 year old dishwasher that this replaced was far quieter. how can that be? Definitely we do not recommend this thing unless it was half the price.

Sentence (English): This is the dishwasher I chose after a friend recommended it.
Comments (English): This is the dishwasher I chose after a friend recommended it. As you probably know, all small and medium-sized brands in Korea are made by this company. Just because they're branded differently doesn't mean they lack quality. While searching YouTube for reviews, I found that this was once sold under the SK Magic brand. I'm a fan of mint, so I chose this because it was the only one in that color. The slim design was exactly what I wanted, and upon first use, it surprisingly cleaned well. However, perhaps because I'm still unfamiliar with it, Tetris is quite challenging. As a single-person household, there are moments when I realize, "Oh, I could just wash the dishes by hand." Because it's slim, it's a bit tall, but the top basket is removable, so I can wash longer items. But did this product not have a drying function? The manual says to dry at the end of the cycle, but it seems to just dry naturally. There doesn't seem to be a separate drying mode or fan. Anyway, the mint color is so pretty. Especially since the kitchen is small, I moved the existing drying rack and put it in its place, but the drying rack keeps appearing. I think I need a drying rack even if I have a dishwasher. Oh, and where should I put that?

Comments (English): [ Very good ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. My Dear 12-seater dishwasher. We no longer play rock-paper-scissors over dishes. Hey, do you know what we said the most during the first year of marriage? "Honey, who's going to do the dishes?" "Who puts the dirty dishes in?" We used to be like that, but now? We both put the dishes in the dishwasher and do our own thing. I had a chance to try this product as a Coupang Experience Group member (I used it for about two weeks). I used to have back pain, so standing up to wash dishes was so hard. Johee's house is freestanding! It's a lease. Kitchen interior? There's nothing like that. But it goes well even when set up separately. I used to rearrange the shelves, but I don't think that's necessary. It's a large capacity for 12 people! Pots, frying pans, plates, and even baby dishes piled up for three meals all fit in one room. It's three-tiered, so spoons on top, plates in the middle, and pots on the bottom. They stack up well! The highlight is the automatic door opening function! When it's done, the door opens by itself with a "pop". At first, I'd run over and say, "Honey! Why is it open?" But now, even that's cute. When I see dishes getting fluffy as they deflate, I just pat them in amazement. Conclusion: This is really cost-effective, has great cleaning power, is easy to install, and has an automatic door opening and app control, so I can control it from outside if I forget to turn it on! I used to lose peace of mind while washing dishes, but now I've found peace in front of the dishwasher. Who washes dishes by hand these days?! We just trust the machine and sit down to watch the drama. (And we watch it again because we are surprised by the sound of the door opening^^) It is a bit big, so it might not fit the height of the sink in an apartment or villa, but it can also be used as a freestanding device, so consider it!

Sentence (English): MyDea Dishwasher 12-Person, White, MDWEF1233G(W)-KR, Installation Room User - Couple in their 30s + 5-Year-Old Child.
Comments (English): [ I understand why everyone is using the dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. MyDea Dishwasher 12-Person, White, MDWEF1233G(W)-KR, Installation Room User - Couple in their 30s + 5-Year-Old Child. Finally, we have a dishwasher aunt in our home. These days, I'm truly experiencing why we call it "aunt, aunt"—a dryer, a robot vacuum cleaner, and finally, a dishwasher. As soon as I received the dishwasher, I stocked up on ProX detergent (basic, baking soda). I usually fill it to the brim and run it once a day, and I use the standard-sized detergents one at a time, without cutting them. Let's delve into this dishwasher review in more detail. 1. Value for money—I think the price is definitely the best! Considering a 12-person machine costs at least a million won, I wondered if the performance was so good at such a low price. However, after using it every day, I've only had one complaint about the dishwasher's performance! (I'll write this down below!) This brand washes dishes this well, so how much better are expensive brands? I don't think the performance is that different! 2 Performance - As I wrote above, it washes dishes very well. I had two questions while using the Mydia dishwasher. 1. Why are there still water marks? I used the most famous and good detergent, but I had a question, so I looked it up and it said, 'When washing at high temperatures and drying quickly, limescale such as minerals in the water can remain on the surface of the dishes, causing white marks or water marks.' I was wondering if I should buy a rinse aid because I heard that it definitely reduces or eliminates water marks if you use a rinse aid, but I heard that putting vinegar in the rinse aid compartment is one way to do it, so I'm going to give it a try and think about it! 2. As I wrote about the fishy smell of water, I only felt the fishy smell once while using ProX baking soda, and it was a bit disgusting. Before I brought in the dishwasher, I used to wash the dishes with the hottest water while wearing rubber gloves, but the standard mode of the dishwasher was lukewarm compared to the water temperature I usually wash dishes with. So, I turned it on high temperature and there was no smell at all! This part was also neatly resolved. Conclusion: After turning it on once a day, the course I have settled on now is [High temperature wash - automatic door opening]. When I set it like this, it takes about 1 hour and 30 minutes. I did not set the drying separately, but after it was finished, I took it out in steps and let it dry naturally, and it dried well! There was no smell, maybe because I washed it with hot water! And on the first shelf, which is the lowest shelf, I put pots and pans, large bowls, cutting boards, etc. On the second shelf, I put plates, regular bowls, cups, etc. On the third shelf, I keep scissors, knives, and children's chopsticks and rotate them. Since there are three of us, I rotate all the dishes we use for the day at once after dinner, which is perfect! It's really nice because I have less time for housework and I have more free time. Auntie, the dishwasher is the best!

Sentence (English): These days, I'm truly experiencing why we call it "aunt, aunt"—a dryer, a robot vacuum cleaner, and finally, a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ I understand why everyone is using the dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. MyDea Dishwasher 12-Person, White, MDWEF1233G(W)-KR, Installation Room User - Couple in their 30s + 5-Year-Old Child. Finally, we have a dishwasher aunt in our home. These days, I'm truly experiencing why we call it "aunt, aunt"—a dryer, a robot vacuum cleaner, and finally, a dishwasher. As soon as I received the dishwasher, I stocked up on ProX detergent (basic, baking soda). I usually fill it to the brim and run it once a day, and I use the standard-sized detergents one at a time, without cutting them. Let's delve into this dishwasher review in more detail. 1. Value for money—I think the price is definitely the best! Considering a 12-person machine costs at least a million won, I wondered if the performance was so good at such a low price. However, after using it every day, I've only had one complaint about the dishwasher's performance! (I'll write this down below!) This brand washes dishes this well, so how much better are expensive brands? I don't think the performance is that different! 2 Performance - As I wrote above, it washes dishes very well. I had two questions while using the Mydia dishwasher. 1. Why are there still water marks? I used the most famous and good detergent, but I had a question, so I looked it up and it said, 'When washing at high temperatures and drying quickly, limescale such as minerals in the water can remain on the surface of the dishes, causing white marks or water marks.' I was wondering if I should buy a rinse aid because I heard that it definitely reduces or eliminates water marks if you use a rinse aid, but I heard that putting vinegar in the rinse aid compartment is one way to do it, so I'm going to give it a try and think about it! 2. As I wrote about the fishy smell of water, I only felt the fishy smell once while using ProX baking soda, and it was a bit disgusting. Before I brought in the dishwasher, I used to wash the dishes with the hottest water while wearing rubber gloves, but the standard mode of the dishwasher was lukewarm compared to the water temperature I usually wash dishes with. So, I turned it on high temperature and there was no smell at all! This part was also neatly resolved. Conclusion: After turning it on once a day, the course I have settled on now is [High temperature wash - automatic door opening]. When I set it like this, it takes about 1 hour and 30 minutes. I did not set the drying separately, but after it was finished, I took it out in steps and let it dry naturally, and it dried well! There was no smell, maybe because I washed it with hot water! And on the first shelf, which is the lowest shelf, I put pots and pans, large bowls, cutting boards, etc. On the second shelf, I put plates, regular bowls, cups, etc. On the third shelf, I keep scissors, knives, and children's chopsticks and rotate them. Since there are three of us, I rotate all the dishes we use for the day at once after dinner, which is perfect! It's really nice because I have less time for housework and I have more free time. Auntie, the dishwasher is the best!
